synergy.reason: Can safely dish out massive AoE damage while Lian Po knocks up multiple enemies.
Creates openings for the marksman to safely deal damage through strong teamfight initiation.

counters.reason: Kites the tank with high mobility while slowly whittling them down with true damage.
Easily bypasses Lian Po's durability and passive with long-range poke and percentage-based damage.

passive.description:
Lian Po has crowd control immunity while using his skills.
When in combat, Lian Po gains Battle Spirit continuously, and his Basic Attacks and skills grant more Battle Spirit on hit. Battle Spirit provides 0-20% damage reduction (based on the value of Battle Spirit). At max Battle Spirit, his Attack Speed is increased by 30%.
When out of combat, Battle Spirit diminishes over time, and is converted to 70(70 + 1.5% Health) Health recovery each time it diminishes, for up to 10 times in total.

skill1.description:
Lian Po dashes in the target direction, dealing 55 (55 + 15% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies in his path and launching them for 0.5s. He also deals 5% of the target's Health as physical damage to heroes and 183 (5% of his Health) as physical damage to non-hero units.
Passive: Lian Po's every third Basic Attack is a heavy strike that deals 250 (250 + 100% extra physical attack) extra physical damage.

skill2.description:
Lian Po charges up and slams the ground, gaining a shield that negates 360 (360 + 8.5% extra Health) damage for 5s. While charging, he slows enemies within range by 15% and pulls non-hero enemies toward him.
After 1s, the ground splits, dealing 350 (350 + 90% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies. Enemies closer to the epicenter take more damage, up to an extra 100%. If any enemies are within range when charging begins, Skill 1's CD is reset.
He can use other skills while using Skill 2.

skill3.description:
Lian Po leaps to the target location and hammers the ground 3 times. The direction of each strike can be adjusted using the movement wheel.
Strike 1: He deals 220 (220 + 50% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and slows them by 15% for 1s. Enemies in the center take an extra (60% extra physical attack) physical damage.
Strike 2: He deals 440 (440 + 100% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and slows them by 30% for 1s. Enemies in the center take an extra (90% extra physical attack) physical damage.
Strike 3: He deals 660 (660 + 150% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and launches them for 1s. He also deals 10% of the target's Health as physical damage to heroes and 10% of his Health as physical damage to non-hero units. Enemies in the center take an extra (150% extra physical attack) physical damage.
He can use Skill 1 while his Ultimate is in effect.

synergy.reason: Pulls enemies together, making it much easier for her to land knockups and her ultimate on multiple targets.
Can lock down powerful enemy assassins, creating a safe backline environment for her to deal damage.

counters.reason: Quickly closes the gap from a distance and bursts her squishy down before she can get her skill combo off.
Can safely interrupt and harass her from afar using long-range stuns.

passive.description: Skills hitting enemies grant 25% Movement Speed.

skill1.description: Throws a fan that returns, dealing damage to enemies on the way out and back.

skill2.description: Summons a whirlwind at target location, knocking up enemies.

skill3.description: Calls down meteors on nearby enemies, dealing heavy magical damage.

synergy.reason: Combines with his ultimate knockup to instantly wipe out enemies with massive magic burst damage.
Significantly boosts his survivability with shields and healing after he dives into the enemy team.

counters.reason: Completely shuts down their mobility with a strong suppression skill, leaving them vulnerable to focus fire.
Stops his engage and prevents his escape using continuous stuns and shields.

passive.description: Zilong gets stronger the more he fights. As his Health declines, his potential is triggered: he enjoys greater damage reduction, and his basic skills are enhanced. Hidden Dragon: When his Health is more than 70% and less than or equal to 100%, he gains 5% damage reduction. Dragon Portent: When his Health is more than 40% and less than or equal to 70%, he gains 10% damage reduction. Dragon in Flight: When his Health is more than 0% and less than or equal to 40%, he gains 20% damage reduction. Any Health in excess of the current bracket will be converted into a permanent shield. When a shield Health bracket is full, excess shield value will be converted into Health instead.

skill1.description: Zilong charges forward with his spear, dealing 350 (350 + 120% extra physical damage). The next Basic Attack is enhanced and deals an extra 120 (120 + 40% extra physical damage) and slows the enemy by 25% for 2s. This skill's cooldown is reset each time his Health enters a new bracket. Dash distance increases with skill level.

skill2.description: Zilong jabs 5 times, with each jab dealing 200 (200 + 65% extra physical damage) to enemies hit and restoring 65 (65 + 2.5% extra Health). The effect of each subsequent jab is reduced by 8%.

skill3.description: Zilong leaps into the air and delivers a lightning strike, dealing 550 (550 + 150% extra physical damage) to enemies within range and marking them with an induction effect: skills hitting marked targets within the next 5s deal 30 (30 + 10% extra magical damage), and launch enemies in the center of the area (for 1s). Returns 50% cooldown if it misses enemy heroes.

synergy.reason: Groups enemies together, making it much easier to trap multiple targets inside the ultimate's barrier.
Excels at buffing allies and CCing enemies, making it much easier for him to land his long-range stuns.

counters.reason: Can easily interrupt his ultimate channel with wide AoE CC and skill resets.
Dives straight onto the backline, completely shutting down his advantage as a long-range poke hero.

passive.description:
Every 4th Basic Attack is enhanced, dealing 450 (450 + 70% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and knocking them back for 0.75s.
Whenever he uses a skill, he gains 1 stack of shield for 3s, for up to 3 stacks. Each stack negates 300 (300 + 35% magical attack) damage.

skill1.description: Mozi dashes in the target direction, dealing 250 (250 + 38% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in his path and enhancing his next Basic Attack.

skill2.description:
Mozi fires a shell in the target direction. The shell explodes upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, leaving behind an electrified crater.
The explosion deals 525 (525 + 45% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and stuns them for 1s.
The electrified crater lasts for 4s and deals 50 (50 + 5% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range every 0.5s.

skill3.description: Mozi creates an energy barrier around himself that lasts for up to 3.3s. Every 0.5s, it deals 200 (200 + 45% magical attack) magical damage and stuns enemies it touches.

synergy.reason: Combines Da Ji's reliable point-and-click stun with Sun Wukong's high burst damage for instant kills.
Easily secures chain kills with assassin skill resets after Da Ji bursts down enemy health bars.

counters.reason: Can tank the combo with heavy sword damage reduction and retaliate with devastating burst damage.
Instantly one-shots the squishy Da Ji from stealth before she can even cast a skill.

passive.description: Every time Daji's skills deal damage, she places 1 stack of Captivated on the target, for up to 3 stacks. Each stack reduces the enemy's [icon] for 3s by 36-72, depending on her level.

skill1.description: Daji unleashes a soul blast in the target direction, dealing 570 (570 + 120% [icon]) magical damage to enemies in its path.

skill2.description: Daji casts a love spell on an enemy, dealing 285 (285 + 66% [icon]) magical damage and stunning them for 1.5s.

skill3.description:
Daji releases 5 hearts that attack enemies within range at random, each heart dealing 325 (325 + 75% [icon]) magical damage.
When multiple hearts hit the same target, subsequent hearts only deal 50% magical damage.

synergy.reason: Acts as a solid frontline to peel enemies, allowing Garuda to safely continuously poke from a distance.
Locks down enemies with wide AoE CC, making it easier to land Garuda's slow-channeling ultimate on multiple targets.

counters.reason: Excels at long-range attacks but is completely defenseless when an enemy uses stealth to get up close.
Uses high mobility to quickly close the gap, completely shutting down their preferred long-range poke.

passive.description: Garuda's Basic Attacks pierce targets and deal 287 (120 + 100% physical damage + 35% magical damage) magical damage. His Basic Attacks deal 50% less damage to structures.

skill1.description: Garuda conjures an arrow formation that deals 150 (150 + 30% magical damage) magical damage to enemies within it every 0.5s for 2.5s and slows them by 15% for 1s.

skill2.description: Garuda unleashes the power of wishes, gaining 100 Movement Speed that diminishes over 3s, as well as a shield that negates 300 (300 + 55% magical damage) damage. He also deals 200 (200 + 40% magical damage) magical damage to nearby enemies. Passive: Gains 15 Movement Speed.

skill3.description: Garuda sends 90 golden arrows of judgment surging forward over 5s, each of which deals 54 (54 + 10% magical damage) magical damage and grants him 20% Movement Speed. He can use other skills at the same time as this skill. If the skill is used again, Garuda immediately shoots all remaining arrows in every direction, dealing an equal amount of magical damage and inflicting Dread on nearby enemies. He also removes all Physical Attack bonuses granted by their equipment for 2s.

synergy.reason: Locks down enemies with strong CC, creating windows for her to safely dish out burst damage.
Forces teamfights with massive AoE knockups, allowing her to move freely and pick off enemies one by one.

counters.reason: Completely shuts down her mobility with guaranteed hard CC, leaving her no chance to escape before being killed.
Stops her in her tracks with long-range stuns, completely denying her hit-and-run playstyle.

passive.description: Lady Sun's Basic Attack reduces Skill 1's CD by 0.5s on hit.

skill1.description: Lady Sun rolls in the target direction and enhances her next Basic Attack, which will deal 454 (285 + 100% physical attack) physical damage to enemies in its path. Using the enhanced Basic Attack will reset the following Basic Attack and increase its range. If there is an enemy hero nearby after she rolls, her Movement Speed will increase by 80%. This effect diminishes over 2s.

skill2.description: Lady Sun tosses a grenade at the target location, dealing 380 (380 + 120% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and applying extreme slow for 1s. Reduces enemies' physical defense by 10% and marks enemy heroes and minions for 5s. Her Basic Attacks deal 120 (120 + 36% extra physical attack) extra physical damage to marked enemy heroes, and 240 (240 + 72% extra physical attack) physical damage to marked minions.

skill3.description: Lady Sun fires a powerful shot in the target direction, dealing 840 (840 + 250% extra physical attack) physical damage to the first enemy it hits. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its maximum range, it detonates, dealing 75% damage to enemies in a cone-shaped area beyond the point of explosion.

synergy.reason: Provides heavy CC to create a safe environment for him to dish out damage.
Provides great frontline sustain, creating the space needed for him to attack freely from the backline.

counters.reason: Ignores the frontline completely to dive and burst them down with high mobility.
Has physical damage immunity, making it extremely hard to win trades against them in the laning phase.

passive.description: After using 4 Basic Attacks or a skill, Luban No.7's next Basic Attack is enhanced to a scattershot that deals damage 3 times in a straight line ahead. Each shot deals physical damage equal to 65 (+4% of the target's max Health, increases by 1% for every 100 extra physical attack), or 207 (120 + 50% physical attack) physical damage to non-hero enemy units.

skill1.description: Luban No.7 hurls a blowfish grenade at the target location, dealing 520 (520 + 120% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and reducing their Movement Speed by 25% for 2s. He also gains vision of targets hit by the grenade.

skill2.description: Luban No.7 launches a rocket in the target direction. The rocket knocks back enemies directly in front of him and explodes upon hitting the first enemy hero. The explosion deals 450 (450 + 100% extra physical attack) physical damage and magical damage equal to 5% of the target's lost Health to enemies within range.

skill3.description: Luban No.7 summons a blowfish airship in the target direction for 14s, which drops bombs on a random enemy within range. The bombs explode where they landed after a short delay, dealing 520 (520 + 120% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and reducing their Movement Speed by 25% for 1s. The airship grants him vision of the area it is bombarding.

synergy.reason: Enables her to maintain her mobility through CC cleanses, allowing her to safely output continuous high damage.
Cleanses enemy CC during his ultimate, ensuring he can channel his deadly AoE damage without interruption.

counters.reason: Relies on overwhelming burst damage rather than CC, completely neutralizing the advantage of CC cleanses.
Uses continuous long-range poke and stuns to kite, forcing them to burn their ultimate.

passive.description: Enters a Dreamscape every 6s for 2s and recovers 40 (40 + 0.6% extra Health) Health. Dreamscape: Removes all crowd control effects and grants crowd control immunity, 15% damage reduction, and 15% Movement Speed for 2s.

skill1.description: Zhuangzi sends out dream butterflies in a cone-shaped area, gaining the enhancement from his passive skill for 2s. The butterflies deal 400 (400 + 72% magical damage) to enemies within range and slow them by 30% for 2s.

skill2.description: Zhuangzi deals 250 (250 + 40% magical damage) to nearby enemies and places 1 mark on them for 5s, for up to 5 stacks. Each mark deals 125 (125 + 20% magical damage) to enemies. He also places 1 mark on himself and nearby teammates for 5s, for up to 5 stacks. Each mark increases Movement Speed by 3%. Passive: Zhuangzi uses Skill 2 every 7s.

skill3.description: Zhuangzi conjures up a dreamscape, removing all crowd control effects from himself and nearby teammates while granting a shield that grants crowd control immunity and negates 600 (600 + 12% extra Health) damage to himself and all teammates for 1.5s.

synergy.reason: Locks down enemies on the frontline, creating a safe environment to unleash massive long-range damage.
Can follow up on his tower dives and CC with continuous attacks to quickly secure kills.

counters.reason: Kites effortlessly with high mobility, whittling them down with true damage from afar before they can even get close.
Provides team-wide movement speed buffs that easily kite his engage, completely neutralizing his strengths.

passive.description: Liu Shan's skills deal equal damage to structures, and his crowd control skills disrupt them for 1.2s. He pillages parts of structures to recover 280 Health when dealing damage to them with his skills.

skill1.description: Liu Shan activates his shield and initiates an assault, gaining 50% Movement Speed that diminishes over time and a shield that negates 650 (650 + 16% extra Health) damage for 3s. Also enhances Liu Shan's next Basic Attack, in which he leaps up and slams into the ground, dealing 569 (350 + 122% physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and launching them for 1s.

skill2.description: Liu Shan commands his mechcraft to claw at enemies in a cone-shaped area, dealing 580 (400 + 100% physical attack) physical damage to them and stunning them for 1s.

skill3.skill_name: Skill 3: Take It for a Spin
skill3.description: Liu Shan commands his mechcraft to spin its arms, dealing 380 (380 + 110% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s for 3s and slowing them by 15% for 0.5s every second. Other skills can be used while spinning.

synergy.reason: Dives into the enemy team and groups them up, making it easy to land their ultimate.
Supports both engages and survivability through movement speed buffs and healing.

counters.reason: Can completely interrupt their ultimate with a powerful suppression skill.
Also possesses a suppression skill, resulting in getting completely locked down upon engaging.

passive.description: After using 3 Basic Attacks or skills, the next Basic Attack is enhanced to an energized chord that deals 290 (290 + 80% magical damage) magical damage to enemies in its path.

skill1.description: Gao plays wild notes, dealing 340 (340 + 47% magical damage) magical damage to up to 2 enemies within range. When these notes hit an enemy, they ricochet into nearby enemies up to 2 times. When multiple notes hit the same hero, subsequent hits only deal 30% damage.

skill2.description: Gao dashes in the target direction while strumming wildly, dealing 450 (450 + 60% magical damage) magical damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 15% for 2s. Each hero hit recovers 100 (100 + 15% magical damage) Health, while non-hero units recover half this amount. During the dash, he gains 10% damage reduction and immunity to slow. Using Wild Chord during the dash allows for another dash.

skill3.description: Gao performs passionately, dealing 200 (200 + 20% magical damage) magical damage every 0.5s for 5s. While performing, he gains 50% Movement Speed which diminishes over 3s. He also gains 10% damage reduction if there is an enemy hero nearby, plus an extra 5% for every additional enemy hero nearby.

synergy.reason: Provides strong CC to lock down enemies, making it easier to follow up with backline damage.
Groups enemies up and shreds their defense, setting the perfect stage for chain kills and skill resets.

counters.reason: Can tank burst damage and interrupt combos with silence skills and high durability.
Can tank through the damage with high durability and shields, posing a high risk of being killed by the counter-engage.

passive.description: All attacks Arke launches from behind her target are guaranteed to crit, while attacks launched from the front are guaranteed not to crit. Her initial Critical Damage is 125%, and every 1% Critical Rate grants an extra 0.5% Critical Damage. Arke's damage when attacking non-hero units from the front is increased by 20%, and her damage to non-hero units is capped at 2,000.

skill1.description: Arke wields her twin blades and attacks 2 times, each dealing 150 (150 + 65% extra physical damage).

skill2.description: Arke dashes forward quickly and attacks a nearby enemy at her destination, dealing 270 (270 + 85% extra physical damage) and marking the enemy for 10s. She also gains 40% Attack Speed for 3s. Her attacks on marked the enemy inflict 25% slow for 1s and reduce Untouchable's cooldown by 1s. She takes 30% less damage from marked enemies. Only 1 enemy can be marked by her at a time.

skill3.description: Arke goes into stealth mode after a short delay. While in stealth mode, her Movement Speed increases by 40% and she recovers 150 (150 + 25% extra physical damage + 5% extra health) Health every 0.5s for 4s. Attacking an enemy will cancel stealth mode and increase her Physical Attack by 120 for 3s. When an enemy is hit, her Movement Speed increases by 30% for 1s. Passive: Defeating a hero or assisting refreshes the cooldown of all skills.

synergy.reason: Can easily follow up on Zhong Wuyan's heavy CC with guaranteed burst damage.
Soaks enemy attacks and provides CC on the frontline, allowing for safe and sustained damage output.

counters.reason: Uses high mobility and long-range poke to kite, making it very difficult for the melee-focused Zhong Wuyan to fight.
Possesses strong long-range poke and CC, chunking them out before they can even close the gap.

passive.description: All damage has a 50% chance to petrify the target for 0.75s.

skill1.description: Dashes in target direction, enhancing next basic attack to deal heavy physical damage.

skill2.description: Smashes the ground, dealing physical damage to enemies in range and slowing them.

skill3.description: Spins her hammer continuously, dealing damage to nearby enemies and granting herself a shield.

synergy.reason: Enables safe positioning and damage output through mobility buffs and silence skills.
Boosts the survivability of low-mobility marksmen through movement speed buffs and healing.

counters.reason: Uses high mobility and burst damage to instantly delete the squishy Sun Bin.
Excels at poke and mobility, constantly applying pressure while easily dodging Sun Bin's skills.

passive.description: Heino engages in combat in either melee or ranged mode as fate dictates. His skills and melee Basic Attacks mark enemies for 7s on hit. Ranged: He channels the Power of Fate to attack distant enemies, dealing 165 (100% physical attack) physical damage and (15% magical attack) magical damage. Melee: He brandishes his scepter to attack all nearby enemies, dealing 165 (100% physical attack) physical damage and (45% magical attack) magical damage.

skill1.description: Heino reduces his cooldown by 0.2s for each marked enemy hit, up to 1s. Ranged: He turns his scepter into energy and throws it, dealing 410 (410 + 75% magical attack) magical damage upon hit. He also throws 1 extra scepter at every marked enemy in front of him, dealing 75% damage. Melee: He throws his scepter spinning, dealing 260 (260 + 45% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 15% for 2s. He recovers 150 (150 + 5% extra max health) Health for each target hit. Ranged: When extra scepters hit the same target multiple times, subsequent hits only deal 50% of the initial damage. Melee: Recovers Health up to 3 times.

skill2.description: Heino dashes forward. If there are no enemy heroes near the end of the dash, he goes into ranged mode. Otherwise, he goes into melee mode. Ranged: Gains 15% Movement Speed for 2s. For each enemy hero near the starting point of the dash, his Movement Speed increases by 25%, up to 50%. If Skill 2 causes him to switch from melee to ranged mode, both the Movement Speed increase and its limit are doubled. Melee: Gains 100 physical defense and magical defense, and recovers 450 (450 + 12% extra max health) Health while increasing max health by the same amount. For each enemy hero near the endpoint of the dash, his Health recovery increases by 25%, up to 50%. If Skill 2 causes him to switch from ranged to melee mode, both the Health recovery and its limit are doubled.

skill3.description: Heino leaves behind a memory whenever he changes to ranged mode. He creates a field that grants 15% damage reduction and recovers 400 (400 + 6% extra max health) Health. During this time, he has crowd control immunity but cannot move. After a 1.5s delay, the field deals 400 (400 + 100% magical attack) magical damage and he returns to the memory he left behind. If there is an allied tower within the field, that tower returns to its state from 5s earlier. The lower his Health, the more Health he recovers, up to 2 times the base value.

synergy.reason: Uses durable tanks on the frontline to easily stack poison on enemies while keeping allies healed.
Soaks up enemy attacks, creating an ideal environment for dealing sustained damage and healing.

counters.reason: Applies anti-heal and deals burst damage, making it extremely difficult to drag out fights and sustain.
Uses high mobility and burst damage to burst them down before they have a chance to heal.

passive.description: Dr Bian's Basic Attacks and skills place a poison mark on enemies for 7s (up to 5 stacks), dealing 20 (20 + 5% magical damage) magical damage per second. Healing skills place a healing mark on teammates and himself for 7s (up to 5 stacks), restoring 3 (3 + 2% magical damage) Health per second to teammates, and 3 (3 + 2% magical damage + 0.15% extra Health) Health per second to himself.

skill1.description: Dr Bian throws a vial of lethal poison that shatters upon impact, releasing a pool of poison for 4s. Every second, it deals 65 (65 + 14% magical damage) magical damage to enemies within the area and slows them by 30% for 2s. Dr Bian stocks 1 vial every 12.5s. Up to 3 vials can be stocked.

skill2.description: Dr Bian throws a concoction, dealing 130 (130 + 30% magical damage) magical damage to enemies hit and restoring 65 (65 + 15% magical damage) Health to nearby teammates.

skill3.description: Dr Bian detonates all nearby marks, dealing 150 (150 + 40% magical damage) magical damage to enemies while restoring 70 (70 + 20% magical damage) Health to teammates. Each stack of mark increases damage and healing by 50%. He also recovers 400 (400 + 30% magical damage + 5% extra Health) extra Health.

synergy.reason: Follows up on Bai Qi's taunt clump by dropping massive AoE and true damage directly onto the grouped enemies.
Provides shields and utility to greatly boost Bai Qi's survivability while he soaks damage in the middle of teamfights.

counters.reason: Deals massive damage by ignoring Bai Qi's high physical defense with true damage.
Kites and disrupts Bai Qi with long-range poke and CC, preventing him from getting close enough to taunt.

passive.description: Bai Qi gains Shadow Power when dealing or taking damage, which increases his Movement Speed by up to 70 and healing by up to 80%.

skill1.description:
Bai Qi swings his scythe, dealing 252 (180 + 40%) physical damage to enemies in range and recovering 90 (90 + 2% extra) Health.
Passive: Bai Qi has a 20% chance of automatically triggering this skill whenever he takes damage.
This skill can be charged up. The longer he charges for, the higher the damage and recovery effect, up to a maximum of 3 times the base damage and recovery. Effect is halved against non-hero units.

skill2.description:
Bai Qi summons scythes which retract after 1.2s and pull enemies back, dealing 325 (325 + 120% extra) magical damage and slowing them by 25% for 2.5s.
Passive: He deals 30% extra damage to enemies below 30% Health.

skill3.description: Bai Qi instantly gains maximum Shadow Power and jumps to the target location, dealing 481 (300 + 100%) magical damage and taunting enemies. Base taunt duration is 1-1.5s, and every 1,000 extra Health increases the duration by 0.2s, for a maximum duration of 2.5s.

synergy.reason: Locks down enemies with CC, making it much easier to guarantee landing skill 2.
Draws enemy aggro on the frontline, allowing Mi Yue to safely engage, deal damage, and sustain.

counters.reason: Counters Mi Yue's lane pressure with high durability, burst damage, and fast farming.
Can kite and poke from a distance with high mobility, making it extremely difficult for Mi Yue to land her chain.

passive.description:
Mi Yue summons shadow servants when using skills, which automatically attack nearby enemies. Each strike deals 50 (50 + 7% magical attack) magical damage while restoring 20 (20 + 0.5% extra Health) Health to her. Strikes deal an extra 80 (80 + 14% magical attack) magical damage to minions and deal half damage against monsters.
She gains 30 Shadow Power when summoning shadow servants, which grants up to 30 Movement Speed and a 10% bonus to all healing.
She can have up to 6 shadow servants around her at a time. When Shadow Power reaches zero, the servants will disappear.

skill1.description:
Mi Yue unleashes shadow energy, dealing 200 (200 + 24% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in its path.
Upon using this skill again, she manifests herself at the shadow energy's location and deals 200 (200 + 24% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies.
She summons a shadow servant if she hits an enemy at the new location.

skill2.description:
Mi Yue sends out a tether forward, linking to the first enemy hit for up to 4s. Every 0.5s, she slows the linked target by 1.25%-2.5% (increases with skill level), steals 10 physical attack and 30 magical attack, deals 30 (30 + 7% magical attack) magical damage, and recovers 10 (10 + 0.25% extra Health) Health.
The tether will break if the distance between her and her target exceeds 1,000 units. If the tether remains intact for the full 4s, she will summon a shadow servant.
Passive: Her Basic Attack is enhanced, dealing 200 (40 + 100% physical attack + 20% magical attack) magical damage, slowing enemies by 10%, and granting 10 Shadow Power.

skill3.description:
Mi Yue disappears into the shadows for 2s, removing all debuffs and gaining 30% Movement Speed and immunity to all effects.
Upon disappearing and returning, she deals 380 (380 + 70% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies.
If she lands a hit upon returning, she summons a shadow servant.

synergy.reason: Can reset ultimate cooldowns, allowing for double jumps to completely dominate teamfights.
Groups enemies up, ensuring Lu Bu can land his massive AoE ultimate on multiple targets.

counters.reason: Uses high mobility to dodge Lu Bu's attacks while relentlessly poking him from a distance with true damage.
Can knock Lu Bu away the moment he lands from his ultimate, preventing him from disrupting the team's formation.

passive.description: Lu Bu's Crescent Halberd becomes enchanted for 8s after striking an enemy hero. Basic Attacks and skills deal an equal amount of true damage while it is enchanted. When not enchanted, Basic Attacks and skills gain 35% Physical Pierce. While his weapon is enchanted, Lu Bu recovers 80 (80 + 1.3% extra Health) Health on each Basic Attack hit.

skill1.description: Lu Bu slashes in the target direction with his Crescent Halberd, dealing 600 (600 + 200% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range. He loses his enhanced state if the slash does not hit an enemy hero. While enhanced, he recovers 130 (130 + 2.5% extra Health) Health whenever he hits an enemy with his Skill 1.

skill2.description: Lu Bu captures the souls of enemies in the target area, dealing 100 (100 + 35% extra physical attack) physical damage and reducing their Movement Speed by 15% for 3s. Each captured soul grants him a shield, for up to 3 stacks. Each stack of shield negates 350 (350 + 7% extra Health) damage. He converts 25% of his remaining shield to Health every second, gaining 1 Health for every 2 points of shield.

skill3.description: Lu Bu leaps to the target location and creates a ring of slaughter, launching enemies within range for 1s. He gains crowd control immunity during the leap. Upon landing, he swings his Crescent Halberd, dealing 650 (650 + 240% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range. While his Halberd is enchanted, he recovers 130 (130 + 2.5% extra Health) Health for every enemy hero hit. He gains 150 Physical Defense and Magical Defense within the ring. Enemies that touch the edge of the ring take 150 (150 + 75% extra physical attack) physical damage and are slowed by 30% for 2s. He restores Health for every enemy hero who takes damage this way.

synergy.reason: Hooks enemies directly into Zhou Yu's fire zones, locking them down for heavy sustained damage.
Protects Zhou Yu from assassin dives with shields and teleports, ensuring he can keep dealing sustained damage.

counters.reason: Uses high mobility to bypass the fire zones and quickly burst Zhou Yu down.
Easily disrupts Zhou Yu's zone control with long-range poke and stuns.

passive.description: Zhou Yu's Basic Attacks and skills place fire marks on enemies (including structures) for 4s. At 4 stacks, the marks ignite, dealing 125 (125 + 17% ) magical damage per second for 4s and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 15% for 1s. Targets cannot gain more marks while burning.

skill1.description: Zhou Yu invokes a wind domain. Teammates within the domain gain 5% Movement Speed (up to 5 heroes; effect doubled for Zhou Yu), while enemy heroes' Movement Speed are reduced by 10% for 3s. When the wind is invoked, enemies within range are knocked back in the target direction and take 200 (200 + 30% ) magical damage. If the wind domain overlaps with a fire domain for 1s, a new fire domain spreads in the target direction, dealing 100 (100 + 25% ) magical damage every 0.5s. This damage stacks with any existing fire domains.

skill2.description: Zhou Yu calls down a volley of flaming arrows at the target location, dealing 250 (250 + 40% ) magical damage and leaving behind a fire domain that lasts for 6.5s. The fire domain deals 100 (100 + 30% ) magical damage to enemies within range every 0.5s. There can be up to 6 fire domains present at any time, after which creating a new fire domain will extinguish the first one. Zhou Yu stocks 1 volley every 9s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), and up to 3 can be stocked. Passive: While inside a fire domain, he recovers 35 (35 + 7% + 2% extra ) Health every 0.5s.

skill3.description: Zhou Yu unleashes a burst of flames in the target area, dealing 200 (200 + 40% ) magical damage. If the flames travel through a fire domain, a firestorm is created, dealing an extra 200 (200 + 40% ) magical damage to enemies within range and stunning them for 1s.

synergy.reason: Anchors the frontline with strong CC and durability, giving Yuan Ge the space to safely execute puppet combos.

counters.reason: Uses i-frames and high mobility to dodge the puppet's combo and dive Yuan Ge's main body.
Can use stealth to sneak up on Yuan Ge's vulnerable main body and one-shot him.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Occult Arts - Manipulation
passive.description: When Yango and the puppet's Basic Attacks hit an enemy hero, they have a 30% chance of granting a Hero Shard and restoring 70 (+1% extra Health) Health. Yango's Recovery skill is replaced with Hero Shards. He can stock up to 150 Hero Shards, which can be used to turn his puppet into a copy of an enemy hero. He automatically stocks 1 Hero Shard every 10–5s, depending on his level. Hero Puppet: Consumes 50 Hero Shards to transform the puppet into a copy of the selected hero for 10s. The hero puppet possesses all of the copied hero's skills, but only deals 50% damage and takes an extra 100% damage compared to them. The hero puppet becomes stronger with Yango, dealing 1% more damage for every 15 extra Physical Attack and taking 2% less damage for every 80 extra Health.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Occult Arts - Umbra / Occult Arts - Return

forms.description: Yango throws the puppet, dealing 300 (+100% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path and launching them for 0.5s. He then starts controlling the puppet. The puppet's Basic Attacks deal 100% Physical Attack physical damage. When recalled, the puppet purifies crowd control effects from Yango and grants him 40% Movement Speed for 1s, as well as a shield that negates 420 (+6% extra Max Health) damage. When the puppet is destroyed, Yango is revealed and stunned for 2s. He is then unable to summon the puppet for 20–16s. If the puppet remains beyond a range of 2,500 from Yango for 5s, it is automatically destroyed. Normal Puppet: Inherits all of Yango's equipment effects (excluding Revive, Blood Fury, Dark Curtain, and Mana Shield), inherits certain buff effects, and shares Gold and EXP with him.
Retrieves the puppet immediately, dealing 300 (+100% extra physical damage) to enemies along the path and launching them for 0.5s.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Occult Arts - Zhi Chu Luan / Occult Arts - Substitution

forms.skill_name: Skill 2: Occult Arts - Zhi Chu Luan
forms.description: Yango sends out 4 paper birds, dealing 435 (+165% extra physical damage) to enemies in their paths. When multiple paper birds hit the same target, the damage is reduced by 50% for subsequent hits.

The puppet swaps locations with Yango if it is within a range of 900 from him; otherwise, it will move to a location that is 900 from him, dealing 300 (+100% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path. If the puppet's movements have been restricted, this skill pulls Yango to the puppet and returns control to him.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Occult Arts - Shadow Crucifixion / Occult Arts - Binding

forms.description: Yango releases two strings then pulls them back, each string dealing 180 (+90% extra physical damage). Enemies hit by both strings take extra physical damage equal to 13% of lost Health and are slowed by 30% for 2s.

The puppet deals 300 (+100% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies and slows them by 250 for 2s. If the skill is used again within 3s, it will enter its 2nd phase. After a brief delay, the puppet will stun enemies continuously, with each strike dealing 120 (+40% extra physical damage) magical damage.

skill4.name: Skill 4: Occult Arts - Dispersal / Occult Arts - Breakout

forms.description: Yango instantly vanishes, cleansing all crowd control effects from himself, then reappears in the target location after a short delay. Does not cleanse the stun effect from the puppet being destroyed.

The puppet charges in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path. If the puppet's movements have been restricted, then control is passed back to its master.

synergy.reason: Locks down enemies with Xiahou Dun's heavy CC, giving Li Bai safe windows to stack his passive and dish out burst damage.
Creates a strong frontline and soaks enemy skills, giving Gongsun Li the freedom to dish out damage unhindered.

counters.reason: Can completely bypass Xiahou Dun's survivability with true damage that ignores shields.
Uses high mobility and true damage to dodge Xiahou Dun's CC while relentlessly whittling down his health.

passive.description: If Dun takes damage while his Health is below 50%, he becomes enhanced for 8s. While enhanced, whenever he hits an enemy with a Basic Attack or skill, he recovers 220 (220 + 6% extra Health) Health. This passive effect can only be triggered once every 25s. (Decreases with hero level.)

skill1.description: Dun swings his blade, creating a gust of wind in the target direction, dealing 400 (400 + 130% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies within range and slowing them by 25% for 2s. If the wind hits any enemy, he can use the skill again within 5s in the target direction, dealing 400 (400 + 130% extra physical damage) physical damage and launching enemies for 1s.

skill2.description: Dun deals 300 (300 + 100% extra magical damage) magical damage to nearby enemies and gains a shield that negates damage equal to 500 (500 + 12% extra Health) for 5s. His next 3 Basic Attacks are enhanced for 8s, dealing an extra 150 (150 + 45% extra true damage) true damage each. Hitting enemies reduces the cooldown of his Ultimate by 1s.

skill3.description: Dun throws his chained blade in the target direction, which stops upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range. The blade stuns the first enemy it hits for 1s. Dun deals 400 (400 + 10% extra Health) physical damage to enemies near the blade and pulls himself to its location. Upon reaching the blade's location, he deals 400 (400 + 10% extra Health) physical damage to nearby enemies again. Dun gains immunity to crowd control while using this skill.

synergy.reason: Locks down enemies in teamfights with knockbacks and stuns, allowing Zhen Ji to easily land her skills and ultimate on multiple targets.
Compensates for Zhen Ji's low mobility with speed buffs, and locks down enemies to easily proc her freezing passive.

counters.reason: Uses untargetability and high mobility to bypass Zhen Ji's CC and instantly burst her squishy down.
Bursts Zhen Ji down with long-range dives and silences before she can even cast a single skill.

passive.description: Every time Lady Zhen's skills deal damage, she places a frozen mark on the enemy for 7s, up to 3 stacks. At max stacks, the target takes 250 (250 + 30% magical attack) magical damage and is frozen for 0.75s. The duration of repeated freeze effects is reduced to 0.5s.

skill1.description: Lady Zhen conjures icicles at the target location, blocking heroes and dealing 500 (500 + 70% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and launching them for 1s. The icicles last 8s and continuously inflict 10% slow on nearby enemies. If Lady Zhen is within range when the icicles are conjured, she will be frozen in an invincible state for 3s. The icicles shatter violently when the skill ends or is canceled, dealing 150 (150 + 35% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies and inflicting 10% slow for 3s. Damage is doubled at the center.

skill2.description:
Lady Zhen fires a water orb at the target which bounces between nearby enemy units up to 5-7 times (max number increases when skill level reaches 3 and 5). Each bounce deals 230 (230 + 40% magical attack) magical damage to enemies.
Icicles are considered targets. Once the orb is unable to continue bouncing, it will disappear at its current target's location after a 3s delay.

skill3.description:
Lady Zhen unleashes a water spirit in the target direction, knocking back non-hero units. Upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, the water spirit forms a pool, dealing 300 (300 + 65% magical attack) magical damage to the first hero hit and reducing their Movement Speed by 90% for 1s.
The pool lasts for 5s, dealing 150 (150 + 32% magical attack) magical damage every second to enemies in its range and reducing their Movement Speed by 25% for 1.5s.

synergy.reason: Can completely lock down an enemy with suppression, ensuring Cao Cao can close the gap, deal damage, and heal up.
Uses stealth and pulls to group enemies up, setting the stage for Cao Cao to land massive AoE attacks and heal heavily.

counters.reason: Overwhelms Cao Cao with true damage and wide AoE before he can sustain through brawling.
Can silence and burst Cao Cao down with heavy sword mode and abundant CC before he can even trigger his heal.

passive.description: Upon receiving damage greater than 10% of his max Health, Fatih gains a stack of Vitality Boost that restores 3% of his max Health over 3s. Stacks up to 3 times. Fatih's abilities have a slightly longer CD.

skill1.description: Fatih strikes the ground, dealing 300 (300 + 100% AD) physical damage to enemies in a small area while slowing them by 50% for 2s. If an enemy hero is hit, Fatih gains 1 stack of Vitality Boost. Skill 1 also changes Fatih's Skill 2 to a dash attack that deals 300 (300 + 100% AD) physical damage and knocks up enemies hit for 1s.

skill2.description: Fatih summons a tidal wave to dash in a target direction, gaining a shield that absorbs 300 (300 + 10% max Health) damage and knocking back enemies hit.

skill3.description: Fatih charges briefly (during which he has Super Armor and 20% Damage Reduction) before smashing his weapon down, creating a fissure that deals 400 (400 + 150% AD) physical damage to enemies caught in it, and launching them for 1.5s. If an enemy hero is hit, Fatih gains 1 stack of Vitality Boost.

synergy.reason: Movement speed buffs and healing support make it easy for Dian Wei to quickly close the gap and burst down enemies.
Provides AoE CC cleanse in teamfights, allowing Dian Wei to continuously wreak havoc without worrying about getting peeled.

counters.reason: Her high mobility and sustain allow her to kite Dian Wei, chunking his health from a distance while denying his engage.
His suppress ultimate cannot be cleansed, completely shutting down Dian Wei's engage.

passive.description: All of Dian Wei's skills can cleanse crowd controls. Each successful cleanse grants Mounting Rage for up to 6 stacks, each stack increasing his Physical Attack and Attack Range for 6s. Mounting Rage: Each stack increases 15-29 physical damage and 35 Attack Range. Cleansing hard crowd controls and soft crowd controls grants 2 and 1 stack(s) of Mounting Rage respectively.

skill1.description: Dian Wei gains 60% Movement Speed, which diminishes over 3s. His next Basic Attack is enhanced, granting an Attack Range equivalent to his max passive stacks, and dealing 220 (220 + 50% extra physical damage) extra physical damage to nearby enemies. When using the enhanced Basic Attack, he will charge toward a target that is beyond his normal Basic Attack range.

skill2.description: Dian Wei tramples the ground, dealing 350 (350 + 110% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies within range while slowing them by 25% for 2s. Whenever his Skill 2 hits an enemy, it enhances him for 3s, during which he gains 200% Attack Speed and 20% Basic Attack Lifesteal. For 3s, each Basic Attack hit also restores 30 Health to him. If he misses, he only gains half of the Attack Speed, Lifesteal, and extra Health recovery effects.

skill3.description: Dian Wei launches a leaping slash at the target enemy, dealing 320 (320 + 90% extra physical damage) true damage while slowing them by 30% for 3s. Grants 1 stack of Mounting Rage for each enemy hero hit. If this skill lands a hit, he becomes enhanced for 5s, during which he deals extra true damage to enemies equal to 2% of their Health.

synergy.reason: Groups enemies together, allowing Miyamoto Musashi to easily burst down multiple targets with his ultimate and AoE attacks.
Provides shields and strong engage, increasing Miyamoto Musashi's survivability after he dives the enemy backline.

counters.reason: Can dodge skills using i-frames, easily turning the fight around even if Miyamoto Musashi engages with his ultimate.
His targeted suppress ultimate can instantly lockdown and neutralize Miyamoto Musashi the moment he dives in.

passive.description: Haya carries up to 3 moon crystals. Using Crescent Wave or Wayward Rays consumes 1 moon crystal. Once all are used, the skills enter full cooldown, and she gains an enhanced Basic Attack that fires 3 extra orbs, each dealing 50 (50 + 10% magical attack) magical damage. Targets hit by Crescent Wave or Wayward Rays will be marked, and hitting them again will trigger different effects.

skill1.description: Haya unleashes a beam of moonlight forward, dealing 350 (350 + 75% magical attack) magical damage. If the beam triggers a mark, the target also takes 100 (100 + 22% magical attack) true damage.

skill2.description: Haya unleashes 3 glazed orbs, the first dealing 120 (120 + 22% magical attack) magical damage, and the next 2 dealing 60 (60 + 11% magical attack) magical damage. She also gains a shield that negates 250 (250 + 40% magical attack) damage for 3s and gradually gains Movement Speed over the next 2s, maxing out at a 30% increase. If she hits marked enemies, they will be stunned for 0.5s. Subsequent hits will only inflict 50% of the stun effect.

skill3.description: Haya links to a hero for 1.5s, gaining 50% damage reduction. The link breaks if they move too far apart, refunding 75% of Moonscape Mirage's cooldown. If the link remains unbroken after 1.5s, both enter the mirage, granting her a shield that negates 300 (300 + 70% magical attack) damage. While inside the mirage, her skill cooldowns are reduced by 50%. If she uses Moonscape Mirage again while inside the mirage, she moves 700 units away from the target.

synergy.reason: Absorbs enemy attention and skills with his heavy CC, allowing Li Bai to safely enter the fight.
Locks down enemies on the frontline, buying time for Li Bai to stack his passive and look for burst opportunities.

counters.reason: Heavily disrupts Li Bai's hit-and-run playstyle with long-range stuns and an ultimate that locks him down if he gets close.
Can guarantee a lockdown with his suppress the moment Li Bai gets close, preventing his i-frames or escape and securing the kill.

passive.skill_name: Passive Skill: Way of the Sword
passive.description: Whenever Li Bai hits a non-structure enemy unit with his Basic Attack, he gains 1 Sword Energy, for up to 4 stacks. Stacks last for 3s and their duration is reset for each enemy hit. At 4 stacks, he enters Way of the Sword, an enhanced state where he gains an extra 30 physical attack and unlocks his Ultimate.

skill1.description:
Li Bai can dash twice in the target direction with Drunken Sword Style, dealing 350 (350 + 110% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies in his path and stunning them for 0.5s while gaining 1 Sword Energy. He returns to his original location after using the skill a third time.
The interval between skill uses cannot exceed 5s.

skill2.description:
Li Bai conjures a Green Lotus Sword Formation around himself, dealing 200 (200 + 65% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies.
The sword formation deals 325 (325 + 115% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies touching its edge, while inflicting extreme slow for 1s and reducing their physical defense by 150 for 3s.
While creating the formation, Li Bai removes all debuffs from himself and becomes untargetable.
When he is inside the sword formation, he has a 10% chance to dodge Basic Attacks from enemies inside the formation (doubled for Basic Attacks dealt from outside the formation).

skill3.description:
Li Bai transforms into sword energy and slashes 5 times at the target area, each slash dealing 240 (240 + 60% extra physical attack) physical damage. When hitting multiple enemy heroes, the damage is reduced by 15% for each subsequent hero hit, for a max reduction of 30%.
He removes all debuffs from himself and becomes untargetable for the duration of this skill.

synergy.reason: Provides shields and peel, greatly increasing survivability.

counters.reason: Has a skill that provides physical damage immunity, completely shutting down sustained DPS.
Can disrupt ultimates with his massive shield and heavy CC.

passive.description:
Every time Marco Polo deals damage with his Basic Attacks or skills, he places 1 stack of Destruction on his target (5 stacks on minions). At 10 stacks, they are converted into the Destroyed Defense effect for 5s, and he recovers 30 Energy.
His Basic Attacks and skills deal an extra 100 (100 + 35% extra physical attack) true damage to enemies with Destroyed Defense.

skill1.description:
Marco Polo fires 5 bullets in the target direction (firing speed scales with Attack Speed) and gains 10% Movement Speed while firing. Each bullet deals 151 (120 + 18% physical attack) physical damage to the first enemy hit and grants Marco Polo 10 Energy.
Every 3 bullets fired counts as 1 Basic Attack.

skill2.description:
Marco Polo blinks in the target direction.
Passive: When there are enemy heroes nearby, he gains 15% Movement Speed and deals 20% extra damage.

skill3.description:
Marco Polo blinks in the target direction, then moves slowly in the same direction while firing barrages of bullets at nearby enemies for 3s (Firing Speed is affected by Attack Speed). Every barrage deals 213 (170 + 25% physical attack) physical damage.
Every 3 barrages counts as 1 Basic Attack.

synergy.reason: Creates a safe environment for dealing damage with massive shields and CC.
Increases stability in the laning phase and teamfights with healing and CDR support.

counters.reason: High burst damage from stealth creates a huge threat of getting one-shot before being able to react.
Can rapidly close the gap with high mobility, making it extremely difficult to kite or peel.

passive.description: Di Renjie gains 1 stack of Swift Justice for each Basic Attack used. Each stack increases his Attack Speed by 3.5%-7% and his Movement Speed by 5%, for up to 5 stacks. On every third Basic Attack, Di Renjie attacks with a red or blue token at random.

skill1.description: Di Renjie tosses a random assortment of 6 red or blue tokens at the target area, dealing 150 (120 + 18% physical damage) physical damage. Enemies hit by multiple tokens will only take 30% of the initial damage from subsequent tokens. Red token: Explodes on hit and deals an extra 90 (90 + 18% extra magical damage) magical damage. Blue token: Deals an extra 45 (45 + 9% extra magical damage) magical damage while slowing the enemy by 15% for 1s. Six Tokens count as 1 Basic Attack. Damage dealt to the same target diminishes to 30%. Skill casting speed increases with Attack Speed.

skill2.description: Di Renjie tosses 8 tokens in a circle around him, gaining brief immunity to damage and crowd control, removing all debuffs from himself, and gaining 25% Movement Speed for 1s. The damage and effects of these tokens are the same as those of Respect the Law.

skill3.description: Di Renjie tosses a secret golden token, dealing 300 (300 + 60% magical damage + 120% extra physical damage) physical damage and 300 (300 + 60% magical damage + 120% extra physical damage) magical damage to the first enemy hero hit and stunning them for 1s. This skill also reduces the target's physical defense and magical defense by 50%, while exposing their location for 5s. During this period, teammates moving toward the target enemy gain 10% Movement Speed.

synergy.reason: Can form a devastating CC chain using their combined knock-ups.
Provides reliable stuns to lock down enemies, guaranteeing a successful ultimate wall-stun.

counters.reason: Her AoE CC cleanse ultimate can completely negate his biggest strength, the wall-stun.
Can cleanse the CC with his Skill 2 and easily turn the fight around.

passive.description: Every time Dharma casts a skill, his Physical Defense increases by 30 and he gains 1 stack of Mantra for 5s, up to 3 stacks. Physical Defense increases by up to 240. Mantra also enhances his next Basic Attack, changing its attack animation, dealing 30 (30 + 30% extra physical_damage_icon) extra physical damage to the target and slowing them by 30% for 2s, as well as recovering 40 (40 + 30% extra physical_damage_icon) Health.

skill1.description: Dharma charges forward, dealing 150 (150 + 100% extra physical_damage_icon) physical damage to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne for 0.5s. When his Ultimate knocks enemies back into a wall, the cooldown of this skill will be refreshed. The skill can store up to 2 charges. Using a skill grants 1 stack of Mantra.

skill2.description: Dharma throws a rapid flurry of 5 punches. Each punch deals 60 (60 + 20% extra physical_damage_icon) physical damage and recovers 50 (50 + 15% extra physical_damage_icon) Health. If he lands 4 punches on an enemy hero or monster, he also deals physical damage equal to 10% of their extra Health, up to 200 damage. Using a skill grants 1 stack of Mantra.

skill3.description: Dharma unleashes a sweeping punch, dealing 150 (150 + 65% extra physical_damage_icon) physical damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them back. Enemies knocked into a wall are stunned for 1s and take an extra 150 (150 + 65% extra physical_damage_icon) physical damage. They then suffer physical damage equal to 10% of their lost Health and are stunned for another 1s. The range of the sweeping punch is increased when a skill knocks an enemy against a wall. The extra lost Health damage is capped at 1,000 for non-hero units. Using a skill grants 1 stack of Mantra.

synergy.reason: Can peel enemies away and maintain distance, safely protecting low-mobility marksmen.
Can engage and lock down enemies, creating openings for high-burst allies to dive safely.

counters.reason: His high mobility and armor-piercing capabilities render tankiness useless.
His armor shred debuff drastically reduces the survivability provided by the passive.

passive.description: When Health drops below 30%, reduces damage taken by 40% for 8s.

skill1.description: Charges forward, pushing enemies and launching them at the end.

skill2.description: Deals damage to nearby enemies and reduces their damage output.

skill3.description: Charges up and swings halberd, dealing massive damage and stunning enemies hit by the blade.

synergy.reason: Their combined high mobility allows them to easily follow up on chunked enemies and snowball with kills.
Groups enemies together, making it much easier to land the ultimate and AoE silence.

counters.reason: Possesses even higher mobility than Sima Yi, allowing him to easily escape or counter-engage.
Can completely peel and protect the target from burst damage with massive shields and CC.

passive.description:
Sima Yi gains vision of enemies casting skills within a range of 2,000 and gains 10 Shadow Force (up to 50).
After using the skill, Sima Yi condenses Shadow Force into a scythe, gaining an enhanced Basic Attack and 20 Movement Speed for 5s. Using the enhanced Basic Attack consumes all Shadow Force. Each scythe strike deals 230 (230 + 46% magical attack) magical damage and true damage equal to Shadow Force. The first attack allows Sima Yi to dash behind the target and deals 300 (300 + 60% magical attack) magical damage (true damage is doubled).
For every 20 Shadow Force consumed, the enhanced Basic Attack's range increases by 3%.

skill1.description:
Sima Yi gains crowd control immunity and begins controlling a spirit with high Movement Speed that lasts 2.5s.
The spirit deals 115 (115 + 23% magical attack) magical damage to enemies it passes through. When Sima Yi uses a Basic Attack or when the spirit's duration ends, Sima Yi moves to the spirit's location, dealing 115 (115 + 23% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in his path and slowing them by 25% for 1s.

skill2.description:
Sima Yi releases spiritual energy and suppresses enemies in the surrounding area, dealing 250 (250 + 50% magical attack) magical damage and silencing them for 0.75s. Inside the suppression zone, Sima Yi gains 10% increased recovery.
Passive: When Sima Yi takes magical damage, 25% is converted into Health recovery for 3s (halved for physical damage).

skill3.description:
Sima Yi steps back and charges up briefly, then dashes to the target location, where he deals 500 (500 + 100% magical attack) magical damage (damage halved to enemies along his path).
If this skill is interrupted, 90% cooldown is returned.

synergy.reason: Can constantly out-rotate and confuse the enemy using a combination of split-pushing and recalls.
Can lock down enemies for a long duration with his ultimate, creating a safe window to unleash maximum DPS.

counters.reason: Can easily win auto-attack trades thanks to superior mobility and damage reduction.
Constantly gets knocked back and kited, making it extremely difficult to close the gap and stack auto-attacks.

passive.description: Whenever Fuzi lands a Basic Attack, he gains 1 stack of Admonition for 5s, up to 5 stacks. At full stacks, he becomes enhanced for 5s. While enhanced, he gains 60 Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed, while each Basic Attack deals an extra 80 (80 + 28% extra AD) true damage and reduces his Skill 1 and Skill 2's CD by 1s.

skill1.description: Fuzi swings his ferule in the target direction, pulling enemies within range toward him and dealing 320 (320 + 100% extra AD) physical damage while slowing them by 25% for 1.5-2.5s (duration scales with skill level).

skill2.description: Fuzi enhances himself for 2s, during which he gains 25% Movement Speed and 45% damage reduction. While enhanced, he reflects 50% of the damage taken after being hit by the first Basic Attack and slows his attackers by 15% for 2s. This reflected damage carries his Basic Attack's on-hit effects. Passive: His Basic Attack has a 25% chance of being followed up with another Basic Attack that inflicts 50% damage and on-hit effects.

skill3.description: Fuzi charges in the target direction, dealing 600 (600 + 200% extra AD) physical damage to the first enemy hero hit and binding them to his lamppost. While bound, the enemy hero will be confined for 5s within the area where his Ultimate hit, and deal 20% less damage.

synergy.reason: The movement speed buff makes it easy to maintain his empowered charge state.
Provides shields and CC peel, allowing for safe dives into the enemy backline and clean disengages.

counters.reason: His ultimate restricts movement, completely shutting down the ability to maintain the charge state.
Her point-and-click stun easily stops the engage, leaving him vulnerable to heavy burst damage.

passive.description: Normal Stance: Guan Yu gains 2% Movement Speed for every 200 units of distance he moves, entering Charge Stance upon moving 2,000 units. When Movement Speed drops below 375, exits Charge Stance, and the accumulated distance is reset after 0.7s. When standing stationary near brush, recovers 30 Health and Energy every 0.5s. Charge Stance: Enhances next Basic Attack, charging forward to deal an extra 500 (500 + 125% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies in his path and knocking them back. Gains 20% Movement Speed when moving toward enemy heroes. When in Normal Stance, he can use Basic Attacks while moving.

skill1.description: Normal Stance: Guan Yu swings his blade, dealing 500 (500 + 140% extra physical damage) physical damage to nearby enemies. Charge Stance: He charges forward, dealing 360 (360 + 120% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies in his path and knocking them back. He then attacks again, dealing 500 (500 + 160% extra physical damage) physical damage.

skill2.description: Normal Stance: Guan Yu removes all crowd control effects from himself and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s. Charge Stance: He removes all crowd control effects from himself and leaps forward, dealing 650 (650 + 200% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies near his landing point and knocking them back. He also gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s.

skill3.description: Normal Stance: Guan Yu enhances himself for 10s. While enhanced, the distance required to enter Charge Stance is reduced by 75%. Charge Stance: Guan Yu summons heavy cavalry on either side of himself that charge forward with him, dealing 620 (620 + 200% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies in their path and knocking them back. He then enhances himself for 10s. While enhanced, the distance required to enter Charge Stance is reduced by 75%.

synergy.reason: The AoE CC cleanse allows her to continuously dance inside her ultimate without being locked down.
Can group enemies with his powerful AoE taunt, maximizing the AoE damage of her ultimate.

counters.reason: His suppress ultimate cannot be cleansed by Purify, completely shutting down her mobility.
High burst damage and silence create a huge risk of getting one-shot before being able to cycle skills.

passive.description: Every time one of Diaochan's skills deals damage, it places a floral mark on the target for 8s. At the maximum of 4 stacks, the marks will be activated, restoring 140 (140 + 1.5% extra Health) Health to her while dealing 140 (140 + 40% magical damage) true damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 25%-50% for 1s.

skill1.description: Diaochan sends out a lotus in the target direction, dealing 260 (260 + 55% magical damage) magical damage to enemies in its path and again on its way back.

skill2.description: Diaochan blinks to the target location and launches 3 lotus petals at nearby enemies. Each petal deals 140 (140 + 28% magical damage) magical damage and reduces Skill 2's Cooldown for up to 3s based on the locations of her and the target hit.

skill3.description: Diaochan conjures a lotus circle that deals 210 (210 + 50% magical damage) magical damage upon its appearance and disappearance. When she is in the circle, the cooldowns of her Skill 1 and 2 are further reduced. Tapping the skill again will close the lotus circle.

synergy.reason: Cleanses CC, allowing them to safely channel their vulnerable ultimate.
Acts as a durable frontline with shields, locking down enemies so skillshots can land easily.

counters.reason: Uses high mobility to quickly close the gap and easily kill her while she's rooted during her ultimate.
Can lock her down with point-and-click hard CC and instantly burst her squishy down.

passive.description: Every time Angela deals damage with one of her active skills, she places 1 stack of Burning on the target while gaining 1 stack of increased Movement Speed herself. Both max out at 10 stacks and last for 3s. Stacks on enemies cause the target to take an extra 10 (10 + 2% magical damage) from her active skills, while stacks on Angela increase her Movement Speed by 2%.

skill1.description: Angela unleashes 5 fireballs in the target direction. When a fireball hits an enemy hero, it disappears and deals 280 (280 + 30% magical damage). Fireballs deal an equal amount of damage to non-hero units in their path. When multiple fireballs hit the same target, subsequent fireballs only deal 30% damage.

skill2.description: Angela unleashes a fireball in the target direction, which forms a flame vortex upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, stunning the first enemy hit for 1s. The vortex deals 125 (125 + 20% magical damage) to nearby enemies every 0.5s and slows them by 30% for 1.5s.

skill3.description: Angela channels a blazing beam in the target direction, dealing up to 12 strikes of 150 (150 + 21% magical damage) to enemies in its way. Angela can adjust the direction of the beam while channeling. While channeling the beam, Angela gains a shield that grants crowd control immunity and negates 850 (850 + 88% damage). Use the skill again after 0.5s to cancel the channeling.

synergy.reason: Groups enemies together, making it easier for Luna to land skills on multiple targets and consistently reset her ultimate.
Provides CC cleanse and immunity, supporting the squishy Luna to safely dive into the enemy backline.

counters.reason: Can completely lock down Luna with strong targeted hard CC, neutralizing her ultimate's mobility.
Possesses reliable CC and burst damage, able to interrupt Luna's combo and burst her down.

passive.description: Luna's Basic Attack has two forms. When the target is out of melee range, it automatically switches to the ranged form. While in melee form, the 1st of every 3 of her Basic Attacks causes her to charge toward the enemy. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals an extra 150 (150 + 35% magical attack) magical damage and marks the enemy for 5s. Structures cannot be marked. For every 1 Magical Attack, she gains 0.03% Attack Speed.

skill1.description: Luna unleashes a moon wave, dealing 400 (400 + 65% magical attack) magical damage to enemies and marking them.

skill2.description: Luna pulls in nearby enemies, dealing 120 (120 + 31% magical attack) magical damage. The attack stuns them for 0.5s and slows them by 25% for 2s. Luna also gains a shield that negates 450 (450 + 80% magical attack) damage for 2s. Pulled enemies will also be marked.

skill3.description: Luna dashes to the target location, dealing 420 (420 + 65% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in her path. If she hits a marked enemy, this skill's cooldown is reset and the mark is consumed.

synergy.reason: Provides a solid frontline and CC, creating an environment where Jiang Ziya can safely focus on poking from the backline.
As a carry, she heavily benefits from Jiang Ziya's passive level cap increase, drastically boosting her late-game DPS.

counters.reason: Can instantly close the gap with high mobility and stealth, easily one-shotting the immobile Jiang Ziya.
Can safely deal poke and burst damage from an even further range than Jiang Ziya.

passive.description: When Ziya deals damage to a target and they are defeated within 3s, he gains 1-3 EXP orbs. When he reaches level 15, Sanctification Power is restored, granting the one-time skill Sanctify and increasing his level cap to level 25. Each level gained grants 20 Magical Attack. Sanctify grants 1,200 EXP to a teammate, allowing them to break through their level cap, and potentially gain EXP orbs. If Ziya acts as a support in the match, he grants additional Sanctification effects based on the teammate's class.

skill1.description: Ziya places a divine seal on enemies in the target area, dealing 70 (70 + 14% magical damage), followed by 60 (60 + 12% magical damage) every 0.4s for a total of 7 hits. Sealed enemies will gradually lose up to 30% of their Movement Speed and 10% of their Physical Defense and 10% of their Magical Defense. If the skill hits any enemy, he gains a 30% Movement Speed boost that diminishes over 1s.

skill2.description: Ziya unleashes divine retribution on wrongdoers, conjuring a magic circle that deals 3 strikes of damage to enemies in the target area. Each strike deals 60 (60 + 12% magical damage). After a short delay, the magic circle explodes, dealing 300 (300 + 70% magical damage) to enemies and launching them for 0.75s.

skill3.description: Ziya channels divine energy in the target direction, unleashing 3 shockwaves. The first 2 shockwaves each deal 120 (120 + 20% magical damage), while the last deals 560 (560 + 80% magical damage). Upon reaching level 15, Ziya's Sanctification Power is restored, and there is a 20% chance of entering the Sanctifier state, allowing him to launch a shockwave while moving. Each subsequent level gained increases the chance of entering the Sanctifier state by 20%. The charging lasts up to 2s, and moving or using the Ultimate again will immediately unleash the shockwaves. Charge time affects the attack range of the shockwaves, up to a distance of 1,800. Shockwaves deal 10% damage to structures in their path.

synergy.reason: A powerful marksman who can maximize the benefits of Liu Bang's global ultimate protection.
Creates a powerful combo by syncing his ultimate with an assassin diving deep into the enemy backline, following up instantly with CC.

counters.reason: Has true damage and %HP damage, allowing him to easily shred through Liu Bang's shields and high durability.
His high-burst true damage ignores shields and armor, easily overwhelming Liu Bang in the laning phase.

passive.description: Liu Bang gains 1 mark every second, for up to 4 marks. Basic Attacks expend all marks, dealing an additional 80 (80 + 10% magical attack) magical damage per mark. At maximum marks, the next Basic Attack is enhanced into a ranged attack that deals 474 (294 + 100% physical attack + 42% magical attack) magical damage.

skill1.description: Liu Bang gains a shield that negates 650 (650 + 20% extra Health) damage for 5s. Upon expiry, the shield detonates and deals 650 (650 + 90% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies. After 1.5s, using the skill again will detonate the shield immediately. If the shield is broken, it will only deal 50% damage.

skill2.description: Liu Bang dashes a distance of 275–550 in the target direction, dealing 300 (300 + 40% magical attack)–600 (600 + 80% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in his path and stunning them for 0.75s. This skill can be charged for up to 1s, and its effects depend on charging time. If the charge is interrupted or canceled, the cooldown will be reduced by 40%.

skill3.description: Liu Bang selects a teammate and starts channeling in place, granting the teammate a shield that negates (480 + 12% target's extra Health)–(960 + 24% target's extra Health) damage. After 2.2s, he teleports to the teammate. Upon arriving, Liu Bang gains 30% Movement Speed and restores 300 (300 + 8% extra Health) Health to himself and nearby teammates. He also fully charges Staggering Charge, keeping it charged for 10s. After channeling for 0.4s, this skill can be used again to immediately teleport to the teammate, remove their shield, and deal 200 (200 + 40% magical attack)–400 (400 + 80% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies. However, he will not gain the recovery effect. The longer he channels, the stronger the shield becomes and the more damage he deals upon ending the channeling early.

synergy.reason: Provides reliable lockdown on enemies, creating openings for Han Xin to safely close the gap and unleash his burst damage.
Stops enemy movement with long-range stuns, heavily supporting Han Xin's engages and disengages.

counters.reason: If his escape routes are completely blocked by the ultimate, he cannot utilize his high mobility and will easily be killed.
Can dodge Han Xin's attacks with high mobility and i-frames, turning the fight around with sustained counter-damage.

passive.description: Han Xin's every 4th Basic Attack launches the enemy for 0.5s and deals an extra 90 (90 + 35% extra physical damage) physical damage with 20% Physical Lifesteal. He gains 25-50% Attack Speed after landing a hit with a skill or an enhanced Basic Attack.

skill1.description: Han Xin leaps to the target location, dealing 250 (250 + 85% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies within range and launching them for 0.5s. He can leap again within 5s, dealing an equal amount of physical damage to enemies within range.

skill2.description: Han Xin dashes backward and enhances his next Basic Attack into a sweep for 3s, which deals 120 (120 + 50% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies within range. If the Fight or Die! sweep is his 4th Basic Attack, it carries the 4th Basic Attack's extra effects.

skill3.description: Han Xin executes a 4-strike flurry with his spear in a cone-shaped area in the target direction, each strike dealing 250 (250 + 65% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies within range, with the final strike launching enemies within range for 0.5s. While using his Ultimate, he gains crowd control immunity and 30% damage reduction.

synergy.reason: Draws enemy attention and provides lockdown on the frontline, making it much easier for Wang Zhaojun to land her Skill 2 freeze.
Overlapping their massive AoE magic damage can absolutely decimate the enemy team in teamfights.

counters.reason: Her high mobility makes it easy to dodge the freeze skill, allowing her to quickly close the gap and burst Wang Zhaojun down.
His strong CC cleanse and immunity skills can completely neutralize Wang Zhaojun's biggest strength, her freeze, for the entire enemy team.

passive.description:
Upon leaving combat, Wang Zhaojun gains a shield that negates 450 (450 + 58% magical attack) damage. Enemies that deal physical damage to the shield will be chilled. When the shield disappears, it deals 400 (400 + 75% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies and chills them.
Her every third Basic Attack will be enhanced, firing 3 icicles that deal a total of 180 (180 + 36% magical attack) magical damage. Each icicle applies 100% of the Basic Attack's on-hit effects.
Hits from her active skills and enhanced Basic Attacks will chill enemies, reducing their Movement Speed by 25-50% and Attack Speed by 25-50% for 2s. These effects diminish over time.

skill1.description: Wang Zhaojun conjures a burst of exploding ice in the target location, dealing 350 (350 + 50% magical attack) magical damage and inflicting chill to enemies within range. She also gains vision of the area and any enemies hit for 2s.

skill2.description:
Wang Zhaojun summons a freezing circle in the target location. After a short delay, she deals 250 (250 + 50% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and freezes them for 2.5s.
She deals an extra 150 (150 + 20% magical attack) magical damage to frozen enemies.

skill3.description:
Wang Zhaojun summons a snowstorm in the target location for 5s. The snowstorm deals 200 (200 + 35% magical attack) magical damage and inflicts chill to enemies within range every 0.5s.
Summoning a snowstorm grants her the shield from her passive.

synergy.reason: Can provide vision and armor shred, maximizing Prince of Lanling's burst damage potential.
Draws enemy attention during teamfights, making it much easier for a stealthed Prince of Lanling to flank and assassinate the enemy marksman.

counters.reason: Can secure vision with his skills, allowing his team to anticipate and counter Prince of Lanling's stealth engages.
Possesses extremely high durability and CC, able to tank Prince of Lanling's burst damage and counter-engage with lockdown.

passive.description: Gao Changgong's Movement Speed is increased by 15-30% when moving toward enemy heroes.

skill1.description: Gao Changgong slashes enemies within range, dealing 350 (350 + 125% extra physical damage) physical damage. He also summons a shadow copy of himself to attack a random nearby enemy, which deals the same physical damage he does. The shadow copy prioritizes attacking heroes with low Health.

skill2.description: Gao Changgong throws a shadow dagger in the target direction, dealing 200 (200 + 90% extra physical damage) physical damage to the first enemy it hits and slowing them immensely for 2s, which diminishes over time. Dagger hits place marks on enemies for 3s. His attacks on marked targets will stun them for 1s and restore 350 (350 + 10% extra Health) Health to him. When marks disappear, the enemy takes physical damage equal to 152 (140 + 12% lost Health) (plus an extra 1% for every 50 extra physical damage). The dagger is destroyed upon hitting an enemy hero.

skill3.description: Gao Changgong immediately exits stealth, charging toward the target direction and dealing 700 (700 + 250% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies in his path.

skill4.description: After a 1.5s delay, Gao Changgong enters stealth for 30s while gaining 15%-30% Movement Speed for 5s. Upon leaving stealth, he gains 30%-60% Attack Speed for 5s. Staying near an enemy while in stealth for over 3s will remove stealth automatically. Movement Speed and Attack Speed boosts scale with hero level.

synergy.reason: Provides damage reduction and CC immunity, increasing Mulan's safety when she dives deep into the enemy backline.

counters.reason: His powerful targeted hard CC can completely lock her down before she can dish out high damage in her Heavy Sword form.
Her high mobility and sustain allow her to dodge and absorb Mulan's combo, chunking her health in return.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Great Wall Guardian
passive.description: While her dual swords are drawn, Mulan gains 40 Movement Speed, and her Basic Attacks and skills place 1 stack of Balance on enemy heroes every second for 5s. At 5 stacks, the marks detonate, dealing 225 (+140% extra physical damage) to enemies while silencing them and slowing them immensely for 1s. While her heavy sword is drawn, her Attack Speed is reduced, but Basic Attacks deal an extra (+50% extra physical damage) damage. She also gains crowd control immunity and 45% damage reduction while using skills.

forms.description: Mulan dashes in the target direction. During the dash, she can dash again by using the movement wheel. Each dash deals 134 (70 + 40% extra physical damage) to enemies in her path. If she hits an enemy during the dash, she can use this skill again within 5s.

Mulan charges up and swings her sword in the target direction, dealing 216 (120 + 60% extra physical damage) - 1,083 (600 + 300% extra physical damage) to enemies within range. Damage dealt depends on the duration of the charge. If she charges up for 0.75s, hit enemies are slowed by 25% for 2s. If she charges up for 1.5s or more, hit enemies are launched for 0.5s. If she hits an enemy with this skill, she can use it again within 5s.

Mulan throws a sword in the target direction, dealing 400 (400 + 110% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path. When the sword reaches its max range, it spins in place for 3s, dealing 160 (160 + 50% extra physical damage) to enemies within range every 0.5s and reducing their Movement Speed by 25% for 1s. She can retrieve the sword by walking next to it. Doing so reduces the skill's Cooldown by 5s.
