Mulan advances in the target direction while slashing 4 times with her sword. Each slash deals 320 (320 + 85% extra physical damage) and knocks back enemies within range while reducing their Movement Speed by 25% for 2s.

Mulan draws her heavy sword and executes a sweeping slash, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and gaining Attack Speed for 5s. She can use her heavy sword skills while her heavy sword is drawn.

Mulan draws her dual swords and makes a sweeping slash, dealing 377 (200 + 110% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies and gaining 60% Attack Speed for 5s. She gains 40 Movement Speed and can use her dual sword skills while her dual swords are drawn.

synergy.reason: Builds a stable frontline with strong CC and durability, creating an environment where Erin can safely dish out sustained DPS from a distance.
Physically peels enemies away, greatly increasing the survivability of the mobile kiting Erin.

counters.reason: A powerful assassin who can instantly close the gap with overwhelming mobility and one-shot the squishy Erin.
Combines long-range poke with rapid dashes to instantly close the gap, bursting Erin down before she can react.

passive.description: Erin's Basic Attacks deal 20 (20 + 20% AD) physical damage and 20 (+20% AP) magical damage, granting her 1 stack of Energy. At 3 stacks, her next Basic Attack is enhanced to deal 30 (30 + 30% AD) physical damage and 30 (+30% AP) magical damage while penetrating enemies. Additionally, she gains 20% Movement Speed that decays over 1s. Erin gains 1% Critical Rate for every 100 AP she has (up to 30%). For every 100 AP she has over 2000, she gains an additional 0.5% Critical Rate.

skill1.description: Erin fires a ring of laurel leaves, dealing 300 (300 + 50% AD + 35% AP) magical damage. Leaves unfold into a ring upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching the maximum range, dealing 150 (150 + 25% AD + 17% AP) magical damage to enemies that touch it and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

skill2.description: Erin instantly gains max Energy, immunity to slows, and 30% Attack Speed for 3s.

skill3.description: When Erin has max Energy, her ultimate is unlocked. Activating it consumes all Energy, increasing her Movement Speed by 10% and firing leaves at the enemy with the lowest Health (prioritizing heroes), dealing 40 (40 + 28% AD + 20% AP) magical damage. This skill can be used continuously while Erin moves. (Each leaf fired reduces Skill 2's cooldown by 0.2s).

synergy.reason: Can provide follow-up damage on locked-down enemies and buff Zhang Liang's survivability.
Can attach to Zhang Liang to provide shields, allowing him to safely channel his CC skills.

counters.reason: Highly capable of peeling for allies by disrupting Zhang Liang's ultimate with massive shields and CC.
Can dodge Zhang Liang's skills with high mobility, instantly closing the gap to burst him down.

passive.description: After Liang's Basic Attacks or skills deal damage to a target twice within 1.5s, he enters a state of continuous attack, during which he deals 120 (120 + 70% magical attack) true damage to the target every 1.2s.

skill1.description:
Liang summons 4 magical barriers at the target location. When touched by an enemy, barriers disappear and deal 360 (360 + 75% magical attack) magical damage while stunning the target for 0.75s. After the stun wears off, the enemy is slowed by 25% for 0.5s.
If the same enemy touches multiple barriers within a short period, subsequent barriers only deal half of the damage without the stun, and the enemy's is slowed by 25% for 1.25s.

skill2.description:
Liang conjures a circle of attrition at the target location for 5.5s. The circle deals 110 (110 + 24% magical attack) magical damage to 1 enemy within range every 0.5s and provides vision of the area. Non-hero enemy units take 50% more damage. He gains 60 Movement Speed while inside a circle of his.
He can have at most 2 circles up at the same time. He stocks 1 charge of the skill every 12s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), for up to 3 charges.

skill3.description:
Liang uses a Power Word to suppress an enemy hero for 2.2s and deal 100 (100 + 18% magical attack) magical damage to them every 0.5s.
If he finishes using this skill without being interrupted, a magic field is summoned at the target hero's location for 0.5s. Enemies that step into the field take 240 (240 + 30% magical attack) magical damage and are stunned for 0.75s.

synergy.reason: Provides reliable lockdown, creating a situation where Mai can safely unleash her full combo.
Provides mobility and healing, making it much easier for Mai to execute her hit-and-run playstyle.

counters.reason: Can disrupt Mai's combos with unavoidable hard CC, completely neutralizing her high mobility.
Can prevent Mai's engage with long-range stuns and shields, tanking her burst damage.

passive.description: Every 5s, Mai Shiranui enhances her next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack deals 100 (100 + 100% magical attack) magical damage to the target and knocks them back. Also restores 10 Energy to Mai Shiranui. When Mai Shiranui is performing an enhanced Basic Attack or casting a skill, moving the movement wheel causes her to dash again and gain 50% Movement Speed that diminishes over 0.5s.

skill1.description: Mai Shiranui dashes in the target direction. At the end of the dash, she launches a flying kick, dealing 600 (600 + 80% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and launching them for 0.75s. She recovers 25 Energy if an enemy is hit.

skill2.description: Mai Shiranui throws her fan in the target direction, dealing 450 (450 + 90% magical attack) magical damage to the first enemy hit, slowing them immensely for 0.5s, and reducing their Magical Defense by 50 for 3s. She recovers 10 Energy if she hits an enemy. After landing a hit, the fan deals an equal amount of magical damage (halved against heroes) to the closest unit behind the target.

skill3.description: Mai Shiranui dashes in the target direction, dealing 800 (800 + 110% magical attack) magical damage to all enemies in her path and knocking them back while reducing their Physical Attack by 20% for 2.5s. She recovers 25 Energy for each enemy hit.

synergy.reason: Dolia can reset his powerful AoE ultimate, allowing them to completely dominate teamfights.
Resetting her ultimate allows for extremely powerful chain-kill potential.

counters.reason: His strong lockdown abilities can disrupt her positioning, bursting her down before she has a chance to reset an ally's ultimate.
Can disrupt Dolia's supportive actions with continuous CC, severely reducing her impact in teamfights.

passive.description: Dolia takes the form of a mermaid while in water, reducing slow effects by 50% and recovering 60 (60 + 1% extra Health) Health and 5 Mana every second. Her Basic Attacks become splashes of water that deal area damage. Her Recovery skill becomes Mermaid's Gift, which can be used to form a covenant with a selected teammate. This teammate becomes the priority target for Celestial Melody.

skill1.description: Dolia sings, unleashing 4 soundwaves that spread out around her. The first 3 deal 130 (130 + 20% magical damage) magical damage and inflict a 7.5% slow. The 4th soundwave deals 250 (250 + 40% magical damage) magical damage and inflicts a 30% slow for 1s. This soundwave triggers echoes when hitting enemies, dealing 150 (150 + 24% magical damage) magical damage. While in water, it stirs up a wave that knocks back nearby enemies and stuns enemies next to her. Echoes triggered by non-hero units have a shorter range and only deal 50% damage.

skill2.description: Dolia leaps forward and transforms into a mermaid. If she lands on solid ground, she creates a pool of water and restores 320 (320 + 40% Health) Health to her and her nearby teammates. While in the pool, teammates recover Health and Mana at the same rate as Dolia's. Cooldown is reduced by 25% if used while in water. The pool disappears if she leaves it for 4s.

skill3.description: Dolia channels for a short time, resetting the cooldown of a skill for a teammate within range. The skill that gets reset is the one with the longest remaining cooldown. In return, Dolia takes on a Cooldown of 10 (+120% of the current skill Cooldown) seconds herself. If the teammate does not use the reset skill, the cooldown of Celestial Melody is reduced by 20%. If the teammate uses the reset skill within 5s, it does not consume Energy, and any earnings from defeating enemies with that skill are shared evenly with Dolia. This skill prioritizes the teammate with whom she has formed a covenant. If no teammates are nearby, she resets one of her own skills. If the reset fails, the cooldown of Celestial Melody is significantly reduced.

synergy.reason: Provides massive AoE CC, creating a safe environment for Nakoruru to unleash her burst damage.
Can group enemies while providing stealth and armor shred, perfectly setting up Nakoruru's engages.

counters.reason: Can neutralize Nakoruru's dive and burst damage with massive shields and knockbacks.
Can easily burst Nakoruru down in close quarters using his i-frames and overwhelming damage.

passive.skill_name: Passive Skill: Blade of the Fox
passive.description: Nakoruru's next Basic Attack is enhanced after her skills hit an enemy, dealing extra physical damage.

skill1.description: Nakoruru commands Mamahaha to attack the target, dealing physical damage and marking them. Her other damage will trigger the mark, dealing extra physical damage based on the target's max Health and reducing this skill's cooldown.

skill2.description: Nakoruru dashes forward, dealing physical damage to enemies in her path. She recovers Health for each enemy hero hit.

skill3.description: Nakoruru flies with Mamahaha, gaining Movement Speed. She can use the skill again to dive to the target location, dealing physical damage, reducing enemies' Movement Speed, and reducing their damage output.

synergy.reason: Absorbs enemy CC on the frontline, creating a safe environment for Ukyo to channel his ultimate.
Can peel for Ukyo with shields and heavy CC, creating openings for him to secure kills.

counters.reason: His high durability and CC like silences can completely shut down Ukyo's skill combos.
Can dodge Ukyo's attacks with overwhelming mobility while consistently dealing damage.

passive.description:
Ukyo Tachibana's next Basic Attack is enhanced to a quick-draw slash that has longer range, dealing 40 (40 + 35% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies and slowing them by 15-30% (scales with hero level) for 2s. Enemies on the edge of the attack take 80 (80 + 70% extra physical attack) extra physical damage. Damage is halved against non-hero units. He recovers 125 (125 + 2% extra Health) Health.
The quick-draw slash has a cooldown of 4-5s (scales with hero level). Cooldown is shortened by 0.5s upon dealing skill damage.

skill1.description:
Ukyo Tachibana leaps backward and slashes enemies in his path, dealing 330 (330 + 150% extra physical attack) physical damage and activating the skill's second phase. If no enemy units are hit, the second phase will be activated after 2s.
If he returns near the start point of phase 1 after using phase 2, he enhances the second phase to slash enemies in a larger range, and his Ultimate's cooldown is reduced by 1s for every enemy hero hit (halved for non-hero units). For every 2% Health lost by the target, this skill's damage is increased by 1%.

skill2.description:
Ukyo Tachibana slashes in the target direction, dealing 580 (580 + 190% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range.
Enemies at the far end of the area are stunned for 0.75s.

skill3.description:
Ukyo Tachibana quickly slashes 4 times in the target direction, with each slash dealing 210 (210 + 65% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range. If an enemy hero is hit, each slash restores 300 (300 + 4.5% extra Health) Health to him.
The healing is halved if only non-hero units are hit.

synergy.reason: Can safely unleash high DPS from a distance by following up on Arthur's silences and knock-ups.
Can easily secure assassinations from behind while Arthur keeps the enemies silenced.

counters.reason: His true damage ignores Arthur's armor, allowing him to easily shred through him, shields and all.
Her high self-sustain and mobility completely neutralize Arthur's close-quarters brawling, allowing her to easily win trades.

passive.description: Arthur invokes the Holy Vanguard to recover 100 (100 + 2.5% extra Health) Health every 2s. If his Movement Speed is impaired, he recovers an extra 100 (100 + 2.5% extra Health) Health every 2s.

skill1.description: Arthur gains 30% Movement Speed for 3s and enhances his next Basic Attack, where he dashes forward to deal 325 (325 + 100% extra physical damage) and silence the target for 1.25s. The enhanced Basic Attack also marks the target enemy hero for 5s. His Basic Attacks and skills deal extra magical damage to marked enemies equal to 1% of their Health. Allies near marked enemies gain 10% Movement Speed.

skill2.description: Arthur summons holy shields that orbit him for 5s, dealing 285 (145 + 80% physical damage) every second to nearby enemies.

skill3.description: Arthur raises Excalibur and leaps at the target enemy hero, dealing magical damage equal to 16% of their max Health and leaving behind a holy seal. Enemies within range of the seal are launched for 0.5s. The seal lasts 5s and deals 85 magical damage to enemies within range every second.

synergy.reason: Can quickly follow up on Wukong's burst damage to secure the kill.
Can draw aggro and chunk enemies, making it much easier for Wukong to safely dive in and clean up.

counters.reason: Has high armor and CC, allowing him to tank Wukong's burst damage and counter-engage.
Can counter Wukong's engage with AoE damage and damage reduction, easily bursting him down in return.

passive.description: After using a skill, Wukong enhances his next Basic Attack, where he charges at the target to deal physical damage. This skill fully benefits from critical hit bonuses.

skill1.description: Wukong recites a spell and gains a protective aura for 1.5s, which blocks 1 enemy skill. If successful, gains invincibility and a shield.

skill2.description: Wukong charges in the target direction. If he hits an enemy, he vaults over them.

skill3.description: Wukong slams his cudgel into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and launching them.

synergy.reason: Lian Po provides strong AoE CC and armor buffs, creating a safe environment for Huang Zhong to siege.
Lian Po's massive AoE knock-up allows Diaochan to safely set up her ultimate and dominate the teamfight.

counters.reason: His high mobility makes it easy to dodge Lian Po's skills, and his true damage effortlessly shreds through tanks.
His true damage ignores armor and shields, rendering Lian Po's tankiness completely useless.

passive.description: Lapulapu gains 100 Physical and Magical Defense. When there are teammates within a range of 800, the teammate with the lowest Health also gains this bonus. When there are no teammates within range, Lapulapu gains an extra 50% Physical and Magical Defense.

skill1.description:
Tap: Lapulapu slashes with his blade, dealing 498 (320 + 110% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. This skill's cooldown is then reduced by 50%. He recovers 100 (100 + 2% extra Health) Health for each enemy hit by the slash. Effect is halved against non-hero units.
Tap and hold: Lapulapu throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 498 (320 + 110% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 15% for 1s. After his weapon drops to the ground, it continuously deals 99 (75 + 15% extra physical attack) physical damage. When Lapulapu retrieves his weapon, he slashes nearby enemies and knocks them back.
When this skill hits an enemy, it reduces their physical defense by 50 for 2s.

skill2.description: Lapulapu charges in the target direction, dealing 529 (400 + 80% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the path and launching them for 0.75s. After they land, enemies are slowed immensely for 1s.

skill3.description:
Lapulapu briefly charges up, then cleaves the ground, dealing 650 (650 + 180% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range, launching them for 1s, and interrupting their skill use.
The ground remains fractured for 5s, and enemies caught in the fissures take 80 (80 + 25% extra physical attack) physical damage per 0.5s, and are slowed by 30%.

synergy.reason: Provides sustained healing, allowing them to survive longer in teamfights and dish out continuous auto-attack damage.
Provides massive shields and excellent peel to protect the low-mobility Hou Yi from diving assassins.

counters.reason: Ignores terrain to directly dive the backline and easily burst down the defenseless Hou Yi.
Uses high mobility to close the gap, chaining attacks and silences to burst them down before they can react.

passive.description: Hou Yi gains 1 stack of Chastising Shot every time he hits an enemy with his Basic Attack, for up to 3 stacks. Each stack increases his Attack Speed by 2-4% for 3s. At max stacks, he becomes enhanced for 3s. While enhanced, his Basic Attacks shoot 3 arrows (counts as 1 Basic Attack), dealing a total of 120% of a normal Basic Attack's physical damage.

skill1.description: Hou Yi enhances his Basic Attacks to deal 214 (90 + 75% physical attack) physical damage. While the Passive's enhancement is in effect, using Skill 1 will cause the 3 arrows to deal a total of 120% of a normal Basic Attack's physical damage plus 50% damage to 2 more enemies or structures in front of him within range (without on-hit effects). This effect lasts 5s.

skill2.description: Hou Yi orders the Sun Tower to attack the target area, gaining vision of the area. After a short delay, he deals 480 (480 + 110% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and reduces their Movement Speed by 25-50% for 2s. Damage and slow effects are halved against enemies on the edge of the skill's range.

skill3.description: Hou Yi shoots a flaming arrow in the target direction, which explodes upon hitting an enemy hero. The explosion deals 800 (800 + 120% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range. The arrow stuns the first enemy hero hit for 0.75-3.5s (depending on how far it has flown), while slowing enemies in the explosion's range by 30% for 1s.

synergy.reason: Pulls enemies in, making it easier for Liu Bei to land his close-range shotgun burst.
Can lock enemies down with strong CC, creating openings for Liu Bei to unleash his burst damage.

counters.reason: Can completely shut down Liu Bei's engage with her heavy arsenal of CC.

synergy.reason: Hard CC guarantees lockdown on enemies, allowing Kongming to safely land his combo and ultimate.

counters.reason: Can invade early when mobility is low to apply pressure and disrupt Kongming's farm.
Can survive the burst damage and stick tightly to shut down Kongming's mobility.

passive.description: Kongming gains 1 mark for 10s every time his active skills hit an enemy, for up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, he summons 5 prisms, which circle around him for 10s and attack the nearest enemy unit, dealing 135 (135 + 25% magical attack) magical damage. Prisms prioritize enemy heroes. They deal 40% less damage to monsters and 40% extra damage to minions.

skill1.description: Kongming fires 3 prisms in the target direction, each dealing 450 (450 + 70% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in its path. When multiple prisms hit the same enemy, subsequent hits only deal 20% damage. Each prism triggers 1 Strategic Mark. He stocks Arcane Assault every 7.5s, for up to 2 charges.

skill2.description: Kongming blinks in the target direction, creating magic fields at the start and the end of the dash that each deal 350 (350 + 52% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies. When an enemy takes damage twice from this skill within 5s, they are inflicted with extreme slow. This effect diminishes over 3s. When an enemy takes damage from multiple fields at the same time, the second magic field only deals 50% damage. He stocks 1 charge of this skill every 7.5s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), for up to 2 charges.

skill3.description: Kongming targets an enemy and starts channeling a Spirit Bomb, which deals 450 (450 + 55% magical attack) magical damage. Non-hero enemy units that are targeted or in the Spirit Bomb's path will take extra damage and be launched for 0.5s. Enemies take 2% extra damage from Spirit Bombs for every 1% Health lost. When a Spirit Bomb hits and defeats an enemy hero, Kongming gains a full stack of marks, and this skill's CD is reduced by 80%. If the targeted enemy hero is defeated while the Spirit Bomb is being channeled, the CD of this skill will still be reduced by 80%.

synergy.reason: Combines strong basic attacks and CC to fully capitalize on Da Qiao's rapid engages and disengages.
Teleporting allies in to follow up on Mulan's ambushes gives a huge advantage in teamfights.

counters.reason: Exceptional mobility allows him to dive the backline and burst Da Qiao down before she can support her team.
High disengage capabilities make it easy to negate Da Qiao's ultimate summons.

passive.description:
Da Qiao boosts her own Movement Speed by 30.
When the koi in Leaping Koi Tide and Severing Surge leaps past another skill's tide, it triggers a tide explosion, dealing 140 (140 + 25% [icon]) magical damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 1s.
For every 250 Magical Attack, the skill range of Leaping Koi Tide and Severing Surge increases by 50, with a maximum increase of 200.

skill1.description: Da Qiao summons a koi that leaps in the target direction, dealing 300 (300 + 55% [icon]) magical damage to enemies in its path and launching them for 0.5s. The koi creates a tide that deals 75 (75 + 12% [icon]) magical damage to enemies every 0.5s for 2.5s. Using skills increases Da Qiao's Movement Speed by 30% for 2.5s.

skill2.description:
Da Qiao conjures a magic circle for 4s that grants vision. When it closes, she teleports a teammate to the spawn point, removing all debuffs. They can return via the portal at the Crystal.
If no hero teleports, the magic circle leaves behind a mark a teammate can touch to recall.
Using the skill again clears the mark. If no hero has teleported, 50% [icon] is returned. Da Qiao teleports first. No channeling is required to touch the recall mark.

skill3.description: Da Qiao summons a koi that leaps from left to right, dealing 300 (300 + 55% [icon]) magical damage to enemies in its path and launching them for 0.5s. The koi creates a tide that deals 75 (75 + 12% [icon]) magical damage to enemies every 0.5s for 2.5s.

skill4.description: Da Qiao summons a whirlpool at the target location, dealing 500 (500 + 90% [icon]) magical damage to enemies within range. The whirlpool lasts for 8s, during which teammates can teleport to it by tapping the Eye of the Whirlpool button. Da Qiao and teammates gain a shield that negates 350 (350 + 50% [icon]) damage while in the whirlpool. Da Qiao gains an extra shield that negates damage equal to 7% of her extra [icon].

synergy.reason: Strong shields and peel can fully protect a stationary Huang Zhong from enemy dives during his ultimate.
Holds the frontline and provides chain CC, creating a safe zone for Huang Zhong to fire his artillery.

counters.reason: High mobility allows him to poke from outside Huang Zhong's range and then dive in for burst damage.
Can deal massive damage with high-powered snipes from outside Huang Zhong's ultimate range, winning trades completely.

passive.description: Huang Zhong's Basic Attacks increase his physical attack by 6-12 and Critical Rate by 0.75%-1.5% (increases with hero level) for 1.5s, for up to 5 stacks. These buffs are doubled when he is in Turret Mode. When he enters or exits Turret Mode, the buffs' durations are refreshed, and the buff multiplier is replaced with the multiplier of the current mode.

skill1.description: Huang Zhong unleashes his potential, gaining 70% Movement Speed that diminishes over 2s. If he is in Turret Mode, he can leave it immediately. Passive: He gains 20 physical attack (doubled while the skill is active).

skill2.description: Huang Zhong places a landmine at the target location that grants him vision around it. The landmine deals 360 (360 + 80% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies that come into contact with it, while also granting him vision of them for 3s. The landmine slows heroes by 25% and inflicts 10%-20% Sunder for 2s (value scales with skill level). At the same time, he gains a shield that negates 360 (360 + 5.5% extra max health) damage for 3s. While not in Turret Mode, he gains increased skill use speed if there are enemies within range. Up to 2 landmines can exist at the same time.

skill3.description: Huang Zhong dashes for a certain distance and deploys a turret. For the next 15s, he is immobile and gains 200 physical defense and 200 magical defense. Each of his Basic Attacks deals 350 physical damage to enemies at the center (40% less to enemies on the edge). He returns to his normal mode after 5-9 Basic Attacks (number scales with skill level). Damage to towers is reduced by 50%. Passive: When he enters Turret Mode, the cooldown of Unleash Your Potential will be refreshed. Using the skill again allows him to exit Turret Mode.

synergy.reason: Provides attack and movement speed buffs that greatly enhance Kaizer's single-target burst and chase potential.
Provides shields and CC to boost Kaizer's survivability and mobility, enabling him to run rampant in teamfights.

counters.reason: Denies Kaizer's engage while dealing continuous damage, allowing her to easily kite him in a 1v1.
Hard suppression ultimate completely locks Kaizer down before he can wreak havoc with his ultimate.

passive.description: Kaizer's Basic Attacks and Skill 2 deal 50% more physical damage when hitting only a single enemy.

skill1.description: Kaizer throws a blade in the target direction, dealing 300 (300 + 85% extra physical attack) physical damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them immensely for 1s. The blade then ricochets between nearby enemies (hitting each enemy only once), with each hit dealing an equal amount of damage and slowing the target by 15% for 2s. If the blade hits at least one enemy or finishes ricocheting, it returns to him, and he recovers 350 (350 + 5% extra Health) Health. This skill's CD is also reduced by 30%, and he gains 15% Attack Speed and 15% Movement Speed for 3s.

skill2.description: Kaizer slashes twice in the target direction, with each slash dealing 160 (160 + 60% extra physical attack) physical damage. The second slash launches enemies for 1s. His next Basic Attack is enhanced, causing him to dash toward the target and deal 130 (130 + 35% extra physical attack) extra physical damage. Passive: After leaving combat, he gains 10 Movement Speed and recovers 1% Health and max Mana every second.

skill3.description: Kaizer summons his demonic suit of armor. After a 1s delay, he deals 250 (250 + 25% extra magical damage) magical damage to nearby enemies and enhances himself for 8s. While enhanced, he gains 500 Health, 100 physical attack, 50 Movement Speed, and 60 Block, while also dealing 50 (50 + 16% extra magical damage) magical damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

synergy.reason: Guaranteed hard CC locks targets down, ensuring Xuance's hook combos land perfectly.
Provides CC cleanse and damage reduction to prevent Xuance from being locked down and bursted when diving.

counters.reason: Instantly provides shields and damage reduction to targeted backliners with his ultimate, completely denying Xuance's kill.
Strong silence and instant burst damage can delete Xuance before he can even chain his skill combo.

passive.description: Basic attacks deal extra damage and grant movement speed.

skill1.description: Dashes forward, enhancing attack power.

skill2.description: Throws hook to bind an enemy. Can be reactivated to toss the enemy behind.

skill3.description: Dashes through the hooked target, dealing massive physical damage.

synergy.reason: Long-range stuns lock enemies down, making it extremely easy for Shouyue to land his snipes.
Holds the frontline with heavy CC, buying plenty of time for Shouyue to safely snipe.

counters.reason: Her physical immunity skill allows her to completely negate Shouyue's snipe damage.
Provides shields and damage reduction to snipe targets via his ultimate, blocking potential kills.

passive.description:
Shouyue gains 1 stack of Ambush for every 1.5s he is out of combat, for up to 5 stacks. When he has Ambush stacks, he gains 20% Physical Pierce and 70-140 (+ 15% extra physical attack) physical damage. Every Basic Attack hit on enemy heroes consumes 1 stack of Ambush, while every skill hit consumes 5 stacks.
Accuracy: For every 1% Critical Rate, he deals 4 extra damage with Wild Wind and 2 extra damage with Getaway.

skill1.description:
Places a scouting device that provides vision within a range of 600-1,000 for 300s. He stocks 1 device every 35s, for up to 3 devices. Devices become ineffective when occupied by enemy heroes, and they become ineffective more quickly when occupied by multiple enemy heroes.
Passive: When out of combat and near natural terrain or a scouting device, he disguises himself, gaining 15% Movement Speed and 15% Attack Speed. After losing his disguise, the Attack Speed boost will remain in effect for 3s.

skill2.description:
Takes aim and snipes in the target direction, dealing 750 (750 + 250% extra physical attack) physical damage to targets hit, plus extra physical damage equal to 8% of the target's max health while slowing them immensely for 0.5s.
Aiming takes 2s, and bullets fired before the full duration have reduced accuracy. Up to 3 bullets can be stocked at a time. Landing a Basic Attack hit reduces the time taken to aim by 4%.
Wild Wind: When his Attack Speed is increased by 40%/80%/120%/160%, his aim time is reduced by 0.25/0.5/0.75/1s. The time taken for him to exit the aiming state is also reduced.

skill3.description:
Leaps backward and fires in the target direction, dealing 750 (750 + 180% extra physical attack) physical damage and slowing enemies in the path by 15% for 2s. Upon landing, gains 15% Movement Speed for 2s. Bullets stocked are shared with Wild Wind, and 1 bullet is used with each skill use.
Using Basic Attacks or skills removes the Movement Speed boost instantly.
Passive: Increases Basic Attack range by 15 with every skill level upgrade.

synergy.reason: Strong CC locks enemies down, helping to keep them trapped inside Yixing's ultimate.
Can easily dive in and clean up kills on enemies trapped by Yixing's massive ultimate.

counters.reason: Extreme mobility allows him to dodge Yixing's skills and dive the backline for an instant kill.
Uses i-frames and high mobility to easily navigate Yixing's zone, avoiding CC while dealing damage.

passive.description:
Yixing's Basic Attacks deal magical damage, and skill hits apply 1 stack of Anti-Qi. At 4 stacks, a Weiqi stone is summoned below the enemy, dealing 100 (100 + 10% AP) magical damage. This Weiqi stone is then pulled to the center of Skill 2's Weiqi formation, dealing 170 (170 + 11% AP) magical damage to enemies in its path. He gains 1 permanent Weiqi stone every time Anti-Qi marks are triggered, as well as 5 Weiqi stones every 60s and whenever he scores a kill or assist. Each permanent Weiqi stone grants 1 AP.
When taking fatal damage, he enters the void, summoning a Weiqi stone below his feet while gaining immunity to all damage and 30% Movement Speed for 1s. This effect has a cooldown of 150s.
When Weiqi stones summoned by Anti-Qi marks hit an enemy multiple times within a short duration, subsequent hits deal only 50% damage.

skill1.description:
Places a Weiqi stone at the target location, gaining vision around it for 3s, dealing 100 (100 + 18% AP) magical damage, and reducing Taking Liberties' cooldown by 0.5s. The Weiqi stone lasts for 12s, and if a Weiqi formation is created, it will be pulled toward its center, dealing 180 (180 + 36% AP) magical damage to enemies in its path while slowing them by 25% for 1s. Hitting an enemy in this way will enhance his Basic Attack to deal 223 (120 + 60% AD + 18% AP) magical damage.
At 50/110/181 permanent Weiqi Stones, he gains an extra one-off skill that further improves his enhanced Basic Attack and grants a burst of Movement Speed for 5s. The enhanced Basic Attack improvements are a scattershot effect/17% damage boost/34% damage boost.
He stocks 1 Weiqi stone every 6s, for up to 2 stones. If an enemy is hit by multiple Weiqi stones being pulled to the Weiqi formation within 0.5s, subsequent hits only deal 50% of the initial damage. On-hit effects of enhanced Basic Attacks are reduced to 30%.

skill2.description:
Yixing deals 160 (160 + 25% AP) magical damage in the target area, which expands into a Weiqi formation. Enemies within the central area take 160 (160 + 25% AP) extra magical damage and are pulled toward the center of the formation.
The Weiqi formation lasts 10s. If Yixing passes through the formation's edge, he gains a 50% Movement Speed increase that diminishes over 1s, while enemy heroes that do so gain a stack of Anti-Qi. Each effect can only be triggered once. If Yixing moves too far away from the formation, it disappears.
This skill deals 180% more damage to non-hero units.

skill3.skill_name: Skill 3: The World is My Board
skill3.description:
Yixing's position becomes the corner of a void Weiqi board. After 1.5s, the board takes shape and launches enemies within it for 0.5s. The Weiqi board lasts for 4s, during which enemy heroes cannot leave it. The board adds 3 Anti-Qi marks to enemy heroes over time and exposes their location. If he successfully traps an enemy hero, he gains 1 charge of Sliding Stones.
The smaller the Weiqi board, the shorter the cooldown, for a maximum reduction of 25%.
When the Weiqi board is fully formed, Yixing gains 30-70% Movement Speed that diminishes over time.

synergy.reason: Provides movement speed buffs to compensate for Mengqi's lack of mobility, allowing quick backline dives.
Provides shields and massive CC, creating a space for Mengqi to run wild on the frontline in teamfights.

counters.reason: Silence and heavy burst damage can quickly melt Mengqi before he even has a chance to cast skills.
Team-wide CC cleanse completely nullifies Mengqi's engage and disruption potential.

passive.description:
Menki gains Mass when he uses skills. For every 10 Mass, he gains 6 physical attack, 8 physical defense and 8 magical defense.
He loses 5 Mass per second while in combat, and 15 Mass per second when out of combat.

skill1.description:
Menki uses Dream Power to gain a shield that negates 431 (175 + 150% physical attack) damage for 4s, while also dealing 371 (260 + 65% physical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies and increasing his Mass by 30.
This skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s every time he hits an enemy with his Basic Attack.

skill2.description:
Menki throws a Dream Bubble in the target direction and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s. After reaching its max range, the Dream Bubble returns to him.
Upon catching the Dream Bubble, he throws it again at a nearby enemy, and it returns to him after it reaches its max range.
The Dream Bubble deals 130 (130 + 25% physical attack) magical damage to enemies in its path and places 1 stacks of slow on them for 2s, for up to 4 stacks. The slow effect is dependent on Menki's physical attack.
After retrieving the Dream Bubble a second time, he gains 30 Mass and the bubble turns into a Dream Bomb. He can throw the Dream Bomb in a target direction to deal 100 (100 + 24% physical attack) - 550 (550 + 132% physical attack) magical damage to enemies within range of its explosion.
The longer the Dream Bubble flies, the higher the damage of the Dream Bomb, with maximum damage dealt at 5.5s of flight time.

skill3.description: Menki performs a dream roam, dealing 201 (150 + 30% physical attack + 30% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in his path while continuously gaining Mass. He briefly gains crowd control immunity at the start of the dream roam. Using the skill again stops the roam immediately, dealing 201 (150 + 30% physical attack + 30% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies and launching them for 0.75s.

synergy.reason: Da Qiao's recall and teleport skills drastically improve Gongsun Li's survivability and map presence.
Movement speed buffs and heals further enhance Gongsun Li's hit-and-run playstyle.

counters.reason: Targeted hard CC will completely shut down her mobility.
Guaranteed stuns and massive burst damage can instantly one-shot the squishy Gongsun Li.

passive.description: Arli's Basic Attacks place 1 stack of Maple on enemies for 5s, for up to 4 stacks. At max stacks, she detonates the Maples, dealing 220 (220 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage to the target and enemies near them, and placing 1 stack of Maple on them. If she uses an active skill, she can use it again within 4s to teleport to the parasol's location and retrieve it. Otherwise, she will automatically retrieve the parasol after 4s. When she isn't holding her parasol, she gains 30-60 Movement Speed and 10-20% Attack Speed (increases with level). Every time she uses a skill or retrieves her parasol, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, launching an extra Basic Attack that deals 53 (20 + 20% physical attack) physical damage. She can stock up to 2 enhanced Basic Attacks.

skill1.description: Arli blinks in the target direction. If she is carrying her parasol, she will leave it behind at the location she blinked from.

skill2.description: Arli attacks nearby enemies twice, each attack dealing 300 (300 + 72% extra physical attack) magical damage. Using the skill also knocks down nearby enemy projectiles. If she is holding her parasol, it will fly in a circle around the location where she used the skill.

skill3.description: Arli deals 400 (400 + 90% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies in the target direction and knocks them back. If she is holding her parasol, she will throw it in the same direction. Upon reaching a certain distance, the parasol will continue to fly at a slower pace.

synergy.reason: The link boosts her basic attack range and damage, allowing her to melt enemies from a safe distance.
Buffing a highly mobile ADC makes it incredibly easy to snowball the early game.

counters.reason: High mobility and burst damage pose a huge threat, as he can instantly wipe out both Ming and his linked ally.
Insane burst damage can delete allies before Ming even has a chance to heal them.

passive.description:
Every 5s, the next Basic Attack deals 238 (70 + 100% physical attack + 20% magical attack) magical damage and steals Health from the hit enemy, restoring 225 (225 + 40% magical attack) Health to the linked teammate and to Ming. Ming additionally recovers 4% extra Health.
Hitting a non-hero enemy unit only restores 50% Health.

skill1.description:
Ming throws his instrument. If it hits a teammate, it links to them. If it misses, it automatically links to a teammate within range. The instrument increases the linked teammate's main attack stat by 20 (20 + 10% magical attack) (1 main attack stat = 1 physical attack or 2 magical attack) and their Attack Speed by 10%. If the instrument hits a teammate, increases the main attack stat boost by an extra 25% (rapidly diminishes over 4s).
Enemies who touch the link take 30 (30 + 25% magical attack) magical damage every 0.5s.
Passive: Increases his physical attack by 30, magical attack by 65, and Movement Speed by 7.5%.

skill2.description:
Ming throws his instrument. If it hits an enemy hero, it links to them. If it misses, it automatically links to an enemy hero within range. The instrument reduces the linked enemy's physical defense and magical defense by 10%. If the instrument hits an enemy hero, it reduces their physical defense and magical defense by an extra 25% (rapidly diminishes over 4s).
Enemies who touch the link take 30 (30 + 25% magical attack) magical damage every 0.5s.
Passive: Increases his physical defense and magical defense by 15%.

skill3.description:
After channeling for 0.75s, Ming deals true damage to an enemy linked to his instrument and restores Health to a linked teammate.
If the instrument is linked to 1 target, Ming spends 600 (600 + 125% magical attack) of his own Health to deal an equal amount of true damage to the target if it's an enemy, or to restore an equal amount of Health if it's a teammate.
If the instrument is linked to 2 targets, Ming steals 600 (600 + 125% magical attack) Health from the enemy and gives it to the teammate.
If the targets die before Ming finishes channeling, 70% of the cooldown is returned. The Health spent is slowly restored over 5s.

synergy.reason: Provides strong CC and defensive buffs from the early game, perfectly supporting Pei's aggressive jungle invades.
Long-range poke whittles down enemies, making it easy for Pei to clean up kills in Tiger form.

counters.reason: High mobility and i-frames allow her to dodge Pei's burst and easily counterattack.
Team-wide health rewinds and movement buffs in teamfights severely reduce Pei's kill potential.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Blast
passive.description: While in human form, Pei's Basic Attack range is increased and each Basic Attack restores 5 Energy to him. His Basic Attack also deals an extra 20 magical damage. This extra damage can stack up to 3 times when attacking the same target within 3s.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Striker Stance
skill1.description: Pei fires Inner Energy in the target direction, dealing magical damage to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 25% for 1.5s. Recovers 20 Energy when Skill 1 hits.

forms.description: Pei fires Inner Energy in the target direction, dealing magical damage to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 25% for 1.5s. Recovers 20 Energy when Skill 1 hits.
Pei swipes at the target, dealing physical damage. An extra 1% damage is dealt to the target for every 1% of their lost Health. If this skill defeats the target enemy, he recovers 20 Energy.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Guarding Stance
skill2.description: Pei envelops himself in Beastly Instincts, dealing magical damage to nearby enemies while creating a shield that negates damage and increasing his Attack Speed by 30% for 5s. While the shield is active, he deals magical damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

forms.description: Pei envelops himself in Beastly Instincts, dealing magical damage to nearby enemies while creating a shield that negates damage and increasing his Attack Speed by 30% for 5s. While the shield is active, he deals magical damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

Pei pounces in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies in his path. If he pounces into terrain, he will latch on for 1s, during which he can pounce again by using the movement wheel, dealing physical damage to enemies in his path. If his pounce hits any enemy, he recovers 20 Energy and reduces Skill 2's CD by 30%.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Tiger Form
skill3.description: Pei switches to tiger form, gaining 15% Movement Speed for 1s and enhancing his next 2 Basic Attacks for 5s. First Enhanced Basic Attack: He dashes at the target, dealing physical damage and inflicting them with extreme slow. Second Enhanced Basic Attack: He deals magical damage to enemies within range in front of him.

forms.description: Pei switches to tiger form, gaining 15% Movement Speed for 1s and enhancing his next 2 Basic Attacks for 5s. First Enhanced Basic Attack: He dashes at the target, dealing physical damage and inflicting them with extreme slow. Second Enhanced Basic Attack: He deals magical damage to enemies within range in front of him.

Pei switches to Human Form, gaining 15% Movement Speed for 1s and enhancing his next Basic Attack for 5s. The enhanced Basic Attack allows him to fire a stronger Inner Energy at the target, dealing magical damage to the target and enemies in a cone-shaped area behind them.

synergy.reason: Stealth and a strong group pull make it incredibly easy for Kuang Tie to land his AoE skills on multiple targets.
Ultimate shields and teleportation safely back up Kuang Tie's aggressive dives.

counters.reason: Strong shields negate Kuang Tie's damage, leading to losing trades in the laning phase.
True damage completely bypasses Kuang Tie's reliable shields to deal massive damage.

passive.description:
Biron's mace accumulates charge when he lands hits with Basic Attacks or unenhanced skills.
At 30 charge or more, his mace becomes Electrified. Basic Attacks deal 40 (40 + 14% extra physical damage) physical damage and restore 70 (70 + 1.5% extra Health) Health to him. Skills also receive different enhancement effects, but hits from enhanced skills do not build up charge.
Basic Attack hits accumulate 5-10 charge, and skill hits accumulate 8-16 charge. He can stock up to 90 charge.

skill1.description:
Swings his weapon twice, dealing 265 (265 + 100% extra physical damage) physical damage each time and restoring 100 (100 + 1.5% extra Health) Health, plus an extra 2% of lost Health.
Electrified Enhancement: Damage is increased to 400 (400 + 150% extra physical damage) physical damage, and restoration is increased to 200 (200 + 2.3% extra Health) Health, plus 4% of lost Health.

skill2.description:
Dashes forward, dealing 281 (150 + 75% physical damage) physical damage to enemies in his path. The next Basic Attack after the dash is enhanced, dealing 375 (200 + 100% physical damage) physical damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 2s.
Electrified Enhancement: If he has accumulated 30 charge or more, the enhanced Basic Attack deals 562 (300 + 150% physical damage) physical damage. It also launches and stuns targets for 1s, then slows them by 25% for 1s.
The first enhanced Basic Attack costs 30 Energy.

skill3.description:
Biron slams his mace into the ground, dealing 450 (450 + 120% extra physical damage) physical damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 1.5s. He also generates a shield that negates 900 (900 + 18% extra Health) damage for 6s.
Electrified Enhancement: Increases damage to 580 (580 + 195% extra physical damage) physical damage and boosts the shield to negate 1,450 (1,450 + 21% extra Health). Also generates an electric wave that deals 200 (200 + 75% extra physical damage) physical damage to enemies and steals 25 Movement Speed from each hero, granting it to Biron.
The range of the electric wave increases with the Ultimate's level.

synergy.reason: Compensates for the lack of mobility with speed buffs, facilitating smooth tower sieges with summoned bots.
Peels enemies away, creating a safe environment for Milady to summon bots and land her ultimate.

counters.reason: Ignores the bots and uses high mobility to quickly close the gap and instantly burst them down.
Can easily wipe out entire armies of painstakingly summoned bots with wide AoE skills.

passive.description:
When Milady defeats an enemy, a mechanical minion is summoned to automatically attack other enemies for 6s. At the end of their duration, minions merge with another nearby minion of the same level and upgrade themselves (up to a max of Lvl 3). If there are no suitable minions to merge with, they self-destruct, dealing 200 (200 + 30% magical attack) magical damage (explosion radius increases with minion level).
Minion Basic Attack: 120 (120 + 25% magical attack) magical damage. Health: 500 (500 + 110% magical attack).
Movement Speed: 450 (450 + 10% magical attack).
Minions deal 75% damage to structures. Merging increases Basic Attack and self-destruction damage by 30%, and max Health by 20%.
Up to 4/2/1 minion(s) can exist at the same time. Once exceeding the limit, older minions will attempt to merge or self-destruct.

skill1.description:
Milady commands an aircraft to fly in the target direction, attacking the enemy nearest to it multiple times along its path. Each attack deals 65 (65 + 10% magical attack) magical damage. After every two attacks, the aircraft attacks the nearest target an extra time, dealing 140 (140 + 20% magical attack) magical damage.
Using this skill again during flight splits the aircraft into two smaller aircraft. Each attacks the enemy nearest to it multiple times, dealing 65 (65 + 10% magical attack) magical damage. Enemies attacked by both aircraft have their Movement Speed reduced by 25% for 1.5s.

skill2.description:
Milady airdrops 2 mechanical minions in the target location, dealing 100 (100 + 20% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies upon landing. The mechanical minions activate after a 1s delay to search for the nearest enemy to attack.
She stocks 1 charge of this skill every 12-15s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), up to 3 charges.

skill3.description:
Milady fires a signal device at a target enemy or structure, marking it for 3s. Non-structure units are stunned for 0.75s. While marked, the target takes 80 (80 + 4% magical attack) magical damage every 0.5s and is slowed by 15%. When the mark expires, it explodes, dealing magical damage to the target and nearby enemies, equal to 25% of the total damage taken during the mark's duration.
If the target dies while marked, immediately summons 3 mechanical minions. While the Ultimate is active, allied mechanical minions in range gain 100% Attack Speed and Movement Speed, and will rush to attack the marked target.
Can be used on structures, but does not stun them.

synergy.reason: High mobility ADC; Yao's shields and CC perfectly support his ultimate dives.
A highly mobile assassin; with Yao attached, they can execute devastating ganks while ignoring terrain.

counters.reason: Anti-shield passive and long range make it incredibly easy for her to strip Yao's main strength: her shields.
Overwhelming burst damage can instantly delete the possessed ally, shields and all.

passive.description: When affected by hard crowd control effects (excluding suppression effects), Yaria instantly removes all crowd control effects from herself and turns into a deer spirit for 4s. While in deer spirit form, she gains new skills, and all of her skills' cooldowns are refreshed. During this period, she cannot use Basic Attacks or be targeted, and nearby enemies are slowed by 15%. This effect has a 60-48s cooldown (depending on skill level).

skill1.description:
Yaria directs a soul with her staff, dealing 250 (250 + 30% magical damage) to enemies in its path and knocking them back. The soul will track the nearest enemy hero after reaching its max range, dealing 250 (250 + 30% magical damage) to them, launching them for 0.5s, and exposing them for 5s.
Deer Spirit Form: Deer spirit form ends instantly.

skill2.description:
Yaria deals 200 (200 + 30% magical damage) to the 3 closest random enemies within 5s, prioritizing heroes. She cannot use Basic Attacks for the duration of the skill.
Deer Spirit Form: Leaps forward.

skill3.description:

skill1.description:
Sun Ce dashes in the target direction, dealing 199 (125 + 45% physical attack) physical damage to enemies in his path. At the end of the dash, he deals 399 (250 + 90% physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range.
After a short delay, he deals another strike of equal physical damage to enemies within range and launches them for 1s.

skill2.description:
Sun Ce strides forward and hacks at enemies within the target area, dealing 296 (180 + 70% physical attack) physical damage and placing 1 stack of slow on them. Each stack reduces the target's Movement Speed by 15% for 2s, for up to 3 stacks. He can use this skill 3 times before it enters cooldown, with each hack dealing 25% more physical damage than the previous one.
The cooldown of the Basic Attack is refreshed every time he uses this skill.

skill3.description:
Sun Ce gains crowd control immunity and pilots his ship forward for 12s. While moving, the ship accelerates continuously and knocks back enemy minions and non-ancient monsters in its path, dealing 549 (350 + 120% physical attack) physical damage to them.
He can disembark while moving by using the skill again. When the ship collides with a wall, structure, ancient monster, or enemy hero, or when the time is up, it will explode. The explosion deals 549 (350 + 120% physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and launches them for 1-1.5s (duration increases with time traveled).
He gains 5 stacks of Undaunted if the ship's explosion hits an enemy.
While he is piloting the ship, a nearby teammate can tap a button to embark. The teammate will disembark when they are hit by hard crowd control, when they use a movement skill, or when Sun Ce disembarks.

skill2.description: Shangguan writes on the ground, creating a zone of ink. Enemies in the zone take continuous magical damage and are slowed. If Brush Strike hits the ink, it triggers an explosion.

skill3.description: Shangguan dashes forward. If she hits an enemy or an ink mark, she can dash again up to 5 times. After completing 5 dashes, she leaps into the air, becoming untargetable and raining down ink bolts on nearby enemies, dealing massive magical damage.

passive.description:
Allain's Basic Attack speed is very high. For each attack, he strikes once with each of his dual swords Crimson Shadow and Spirit Guardian, dealing 75 (22 + 30% AD) magical damage and 75 (22 + 30% AD) physical damage. Every first Basic Attack lets him dash to the target. Every third Basic Attack, he swings both swords at the same time, dealing 115 (36 + 45% AD) true damage and then entering a longer Basic Attack cooldown. When his Basic Attacks and skills hit enemy heroes, he gains Fury, increasing his Physical and Magical Pierce by up to 40% and damage reduction by up to 20%. Upon reaching max Fury, he recovers 168 (80 + 50% AD) Health, with a cooldown of 8s.
The lower his current Health, the more Health he recovers, for up to 3 times the base recovery.
His Physical Lifesteal takes 75% effect and applies to magical and true damage. His Basic Attacks only carry 60% of on-hit effects.

skill1.description:
Allain swipes upward, dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) magical damage, 177 (110 + 38% AD) physical damage twice, and launching targets directly in front of him for 0.75s. After the initial strikes of this skill, he performs different follow-up strikes depending on how many marks he has stacked.
1 Mark: Strikes twice more, the first strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) magical damage and the second strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) physical damage.
2 Marks: Increases the launch range and strikes another 2 times, the first strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) magical damage and the second strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) physical damage.
3 Marks: Increases the launch range and strikes another 2 times, the first strike dealing 177 (110 + 38% AD) true damage and the second strike dealing 312 (180 + 75% AD) true damage.
He can move slowly and gains crowd control immunity while performing the strikes.
He gains stacks when his Ultimate and Basic Attacks hit enemies. Skill 1 can trigger 50% of the Basic Attack's on-hit effects, and can grant lifesteal and deal critical damage.

skill2.description:
Allain dashes in the target direction, dealing 144 (100 + 25% AD) physical damage and 144 (100 + 25% AD) magical damage to enemies in his path and reducing their Movement Speed by 15% for 1.5s. He also gains 10% Movement Speed for 3s, and his next 3 Basic Attacks gain 40% extra Attack Speed.
He stocks 1 charge of this skill every 10s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), for up to 2 charges.

skill3.description:
Allain selects a target hero and leaps into the air for 1.5s, during which he can move and is untargetable. He then smashes into the ground, dealing 254 (175 + 45% AD) physical damage and 254 (175 + 45% AD) magical damage to enemy heroes. The closer the heroes are to him, the more damage they take, for up to 100% extra damage. He gains marks and Fury for every enemy hero hit.
This skill produces different effects depending on whether the targeted hero is an enemy or a teammate. When he lands, he grants himself or the targeted teammate a shield that negates 627 (450 + 100% AD) damage. For every extra enemy hero hit, the shield's strength is increased by 1/3.

counters.reason: Her excessive mobility makes it easy to break the soul chain and kite away.

passive.description:
Augran's Basic Attacks vibrate his dagger-axe to resonate with an enemy's soul for 3s. The soul resonance deals 88 (50% physical attack) physical damage upon connection and will continue to deal damage with increasing frequency unless it is broken. When it ends, it deals a further 211 (70 + 80% physical attack) magical damage.
The soul resonance's initial and final damage carry 100% of the on-hit effect, while the rest carries 50%.

skill1.description:
Augran carves a path to the afterlife, dealing 280 (280 + 95% extra physical attack) magical damage to targets it hits.
The path accelerates after hitting walls or the Life-Death Border, then deals an additional 150 (150 + 60% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies hit. While on the path, Augran ignores terrain and gains 50% Movement Speed. The first time the path hits a wall, it creates an afterlife bridge. When Augran traverses the bridge, he gains a burst of Movement Speed, while nearby enemies are slowed by 15%.
Augran can use this skill again to recall his dagger-axe, entering the Seer State for 4s. If his Basic Attacks target an enemy with less than 10% Health (750-1,500 for monsters depending on hero level), Augran will instantly execute them.
This skill deals full contact damage to non-hero units. The dagger-axe will automatically be summoned back when the skill's cooldown ends.

skill2.description:
Augran swings his dagger-axe, dealing 200 (200 + 60% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies in front and slowing them by 25% for 1s. He then leaves behind a Life-Death Border, marking enemies who touch it. Enemies who touch the dead branches on the border also take 140 (140 + 45% extra physical attack) magical damage and are slowed by 25% for 1s.
Augran enhances his next Basic Attack, dealing 50% extra damage to the target and recovering 80 (80 + 1.5% extra Health) Health for himself. If there are marked enemies within range, the resonance applies the same extra damage and recovery effect for each marked target.
This skill also knocks back non-hero units. The resonance can link to up to 3 targets. When resonating with non-hero units, the recovery effect is only 50% effective.

skill3.description:
Augran channels his divine power and descends from the sky, dealing 380 (380 + 150% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back for 0.5s. If he hits an enemy hero, he recovers 750 (750 + 12% extra Health) Health and conjures their spirit counterparts to assist him for 8s.
After descending, he enters the Seer State for 8s. If his Basic Attacks hit a target with less than 10% Health (750-1,500 for monsters depending on hero level), they will deal a fatal blow instantly.
Every enemy hero hit increases recovery by 50%, up to a max increase of 100%. The conjured spirits inherit 30% of Augran's physical attack. They can only use Basic Attacks, but have higher Movement Speed and Attack Speed.

skill2.description:

Landing a hit on the enemy recovers 150 (150 + 2.5% extra) Health.
Recovery effects are halved against non-hero units. Skill use speed scales with Attack Speed.

skill3.description:
Ao'yin unleashes a wave of sword energy, gaining 30% Movement Speed (diminishes over time). He also deals 180 (180 + 45% extra) physical damage (with 50% splash damage) to up to 3 targets within range and knocks them back.
Use of Riding the Wind attaches 1 Wind Dragon Soul to his sword, granting him 16 Movement Speed. If a Wind Dragon Soul is attached to both swords, he gains an extra 50% Movement Speed. If a Wind Dragon Soul is attached to his primary sword, he will deal 97 (48 + 30%) physical damage and knock back the enemy with every strike of his enhanced Basic Attack, for a total of 3 strikes.
Skill use speed scales with Attack Speed.

skill4.description:
Ao'yin reveals his true white dragon form and soars into the sky for up to 4.5s, then dives forward. During this time, he is untargetable and ignores terrain, but cannot attack. He deals 400 (400 + 80% extra) physical damage to enemies in his path and slows them by 15%.

Ao'yin then unsheathes his True Dragon Sword, gaining 20% AS and 25 Attack Range, and the ability to attack up to two additional targets for 10s.
Ao'yin can switch his swords' elemental Dragon Souls while in flight.
Flight speed increases with his Ultimate's level.
