Excited: Bullets have a piercing effect, dealing 50% damage to subsequent enemies. Firing speed is increased by 1% for every 2% Attack Speed, up to 100%.
Tap and hold to use. Damage can deal critical hits. Strafing can be paused temporarily to use other skills. Hits grant 5 Anger, while critical hits grant 10 Anger.
Every 2% Attack Speed increases skill casting speed by 1%.

skill2.description:
Shoots a heavy round in the target direction, dealing 200 (200 + 50% extra physical attack) physical damage to all enemies hit and slowing them by 25% for 2s. When the round hits an enemy or wall, or reaches its maximum range, it explodes and splits into 5 splinters that can ricochet off walls and deal 410 (410 + 100% extra physical attack) physical damage to the first enemy they hit.
Excited: The number of splinters increases from 5 to 9.
Gains 5 Anger every time rounds or splinters hit an enemy. If multiple splinters hit the same target within 1s, subsequent hits only deal 25% damage.

skill3.description:
Meng Ya scans the vicinity and marks the locations of enemies within range when they take damage from his teammates (up to 5 locations can be marked). When the scan is complete, he fires missiles that deal 450 (450 + 120% extra physical attack) physical damage. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 75% less damage and grant 10 Anger. He continues to fire up to 1 missile every second for 8s after the scan. 50% of the skill's cooldown is refunded if the skill is canceled or interrupted.
Excited: The minimum interval between subsequent missiles is reduced from 1s to 0.5s.
The skill button can be held down for up to 3s to expand the scan range. He gains 50% Movement Speed while scanning.

synergy.reason: His strong CC locks down enemies, creating the perfect opening to guarantee the high-burst combo hits.
By disrupting the enemy formation and drawing aggro on the frontline, he creates a safe opportunity to dive the backline.

counters.reason: His silence prevents the spamming of mobility skills, completely locking them down.
Frequent long-range stuns prevent any engages, making it hard to utilize high mobility.

passive.description: When the enemy's Health drops below 30%, Lam will mark them as Prey. Lam's skills and Basic Attacks deal an extra 7.5-15% true damage to Prey.

skill1.description: Lam submerges himself for 3s and gains 40 Movement Speed for 3s. After the duration expires, he returns to normal and 50% of the CD is returned. If he uses this skill again while submerged, he will burst out of the water and dash in the target direction, dealing 300 (300 + 120% extra physical damage) to enemies in his path and slowing them by 25% for 1.5s.

skill2.description: Lam attacks nearby enemies and slices open their wounds, dealing 2 strikes of 235 (235 + 50% extra physical damage) and recovering 100 (100 + 1.5% extra Health) Health for every enemy hero hit (recovery is halved for non-hero units). He gains 1 mark when using the skill, and gains 1 additional mark every time a different enemy is hit, for up to 3 stacks. While he has a mark, his Basic Attack is enhanced, consuming 1 mark to dash and deal 197 (70 + 75% extra physical damage) while recovering 100 (100 + 1.5% extra Health) Health. Each follow-up attack reduces the cooldown of this skill by 10%-20%. When using this skill while submerged, he will dash in the target direction and reduce Skill 1's CD by 25%.

skill3.description: Lam throws his dagger in the target direction, slowing enemies in its path immensely for 0.5s. After a short delay Lam dashes toward the dagger, dealing 520 (520 + 180% extra physical damage) and dragging enemies in his path along with him. When using this skill while submerged, he will drag enemies to the dash destination, and Skill 1's CD will be reduced by 50%.

synergy.reason: Her massive AoE CC stops enemies in their tracks, setting up a perfect engage to unleash skill combos.
They both share high mobility and burst damage, easily wiping out the enemy backline together.

counters.reason: His extreme sustain and CC interrupt combos and movement, making it impossible to secure the kill.
Her point-and-click stun and overwhelming burst damage pose a huge risk of getting deleted before ever getting close.

passive.description: Jing and her mirror image apply 2 different types of marks on enemies when they deal damage. If an enemy has both types of mark at the same time, the marks shatter, dealing physical damage equal to 4% of their lost Health and refreshing the cooldown of Reflective Assault and Shattered Illusions. This effect has a cooldown of 5s (2s during the Ultimate). The damage dealt and recovery provided by the mirror image is only 30% of her real body. The farther the image is from her real body, the greater the damage and recovery, up to 80% of the real body. The image only deals 10% of the real body's damage to towers.

skill1.description: Jing dashes in the target direction, dealing 200 (200 + 100% extra physical attack) physical damage to enemies in her path and slowing them by 15% for 1.5s. Her next Basic Attack is enhanced to deal an extra strike of 50 (50 + 15% extra physical attack) physical damage. If no mirror image is present on the battlefield, one will be created for 2s, which dashes with her and replicates all of her actions except the Ultimate.

skill2.description: Jing deals 160 (160 + 85% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and gains a 50% Movement Speed boost that diminishes over 1s. Recovers 150 (150 + 2% extra max health) Health for the first enemy hit, and 25% of that value for each additional target hit. If no mirror image is present on the battlefield, one will be created for 2s, which attacks with her and replicates all of her actions except the Ultimate.

skill3.description: Jing and her mirror image switch locations. Stocks 1 charge every 10s, up to 4 charges.

skill4.description: Jing flies forward, pulling enemies along her path with her. When she stops, she opens a Mirror Vortex and immobilizes the enemies at its center for 1s. She and her mirror image then move to either side of the vortex's central axis. While the vortex is present, she recovers 17 (10 + 4% extra physical attack) Health for every 0.05s spent dashing with Dimensional Shift. She gains 1 charge of shift if she deals damage to an enemy. The Mirror Vortex lasts 10s, during which Jing gains 10% damage reduction, but it will disappear if she leaves before then. When the vortex is formed, 8 mirror fragments are generated along its border. When Jing or her mirror image deal damage to an enemy, the nearest mirror fragment will fly at the enemy, dealing 30 + 2% of the target's lost Health physical damage.

synergy.reason: His sustained healing greatly boosts combat endurance whether mounted or dismounted.
He provides a solid frontline and shields, peeling to ensure they can continue dealing damage from a safe distance.

counters.reason: His immense mobility allows him to easily invade the jungle and disrupt early-game farming.
He targets the vulnerable dismounted state, and his strong chase potential makes escape nearly impossible.

passive.description:
Agudo has an affinity with the monsters of the Gorge. When she's near a monster, Recovery will be replaced with Release (grants buffs).
Upon hitting enemies, Agudo's Basic Attacks will drop Seed Mines and absorb nearby mines: She can pick up mines to gain 3% Attack Speed and Movement Speed for 2.5s, for up to 6 stacks.
Enemies that come into contact with a mine will take 30 (30 + 10% extra physical damage).

skill1.description:
Agudo sows a field in the target area, creating an animal wonderland that provides Agudo and her animal companions with 15% Attack Speed and Movement Speed, while granting 40 (40 + 0.6% extra Health). Her animal companions will come to the field and fight alongside Agudo. Animal companions' stats scale with Agudo's hero level, while the chance of summoning more companions scales with skill level.
Animal companions gain additional Attack, Attack Speed, and Critical Rate based on 50% of Agudo's stats.

skill2.description:
Tumble, Furball!: Agudo rolls forward with Furball, gaining 40 Block and immunity to 1 hard crowd control while rolling. Also deals 240 (240 + 80% extra physical damage) to any enemies she hits and stuns them for 1/2s. If they hit a wall before the end of the roll, they'll ricochet up to 3 times, resetting the rolling distance while increasing the skill's effect by 25%. Agudo also enhances her next Basic Attack to shoot 3 Seed Mines and deal 60 (60 + 20% extra physical damage).
Tumble, Agudo!: Agudo rolls forward and enhances her next Basic Attack to shoot 3 Seed Mines and deal 60 (60 + 20% extra physical damage).

skill3.description:
While riding Furball: Agudo commands Furball to leap to the target location, dealing 460 (460 + 150% extra physical damage) to enemies and stunning them for 2/3s. After that, Furball will battle independently while inheriting 50% of Agudo's stats and 100% of her on-hit effects.
While not riding Furball: When Furball is defeated, it will enter recovery mode. It can rejoin the battle after its Health is fully restored.
She can call Furball back before the skill duration ends.

synergy.reason: Her sustained healing and peel drastically increase the survivability of immobile, high-DPS marksmen.
Her massive healing pushes the effective health of frontline tanks to the absolute limit.

counters.reason: His strong lockdown shuts down mobility, preventing them from using walls to escape.
His high burst damage carries the risk of being instantly deleted before recovery or escape skills can be used.

passive.description: Sakeer's basic attacks deal extra physical damage and heal him. When he casts a skill, he gains a stack of Blade Mark, up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack consumes all stacks to deal massive damage and heal himself.

skill1.description: Sakeer throws out two scimitars that swirl around him, dealing physical damage to enemies and slowing them down. If both scimitars hit the same target, it deals extra damage and applies a short slow.

skill2.description: Sakeer dashes forward and gains Attack Speed and Movement Speed. His next basic attack becomes a phantom strike, dealing extra damage and teleporting him slightly behind the target.

skill3.description: Sakeer unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing multiple instances of physical damage to all enemies in an area. During this skill, he becomes untargetable and immune to crowd control. Kills or assists reduce the cooldown of this skill.

synergy.reason: Her strong CC locks down enemies, making it easy to stack the passive and chain combos.
By clumping multiple enemies together, he maximizes both the AoE damage and healing effects.

counters.reason: His silence forcefully interrupts skill combos, preventing the passive from stacking.
Her high mobility and kiting make it impossible to close the gap, allowing her to deal one-sided damage from afar.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Splash Light
passive.description: After a skill lands on an enemy, Charlotte enhances her next skill into an Additional Skill and gains 1 stack of [Seven-Star Sword] for 4s. At 3 stacks, her Basic Attack is enhanced to [Seven-Star Sword]. [Seven-Star Sword]: Charlotte locks onto an enemy and slashes 7 times, dealing Physical Damage and reducing their Move Speed. The final slash deals extra Physical Damage equal to 15% of the target's lost Health.

forms.description: Charlotte slashes a triangle, dealing Physical Damage. If it hits an enemy, she gains Move Speed.
Enhanced Skill: Charlotte slashes a triangle with increased speed, dealing physical damage and granting extra Movement Speed upon hitting an enemy.
Charlotte charges in the target direction, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in her path and recovering Health.
Enhanced Skill: Charlotte charges forward, dealing multiple physical strikes with reduced Cooldown and increased Health recovery.
Charlotte slashes enemies in a circle, dealing Physical Damage and reducing their Move Speed. During the skill, she gains Damage Reduction and Immunity to Crowd Control.
Enhanced Skill: Charlotte slashes enemies in a circle, knocking them up on the final hit, dealing physical damage, and granting Damage Reduction and CC Immunity.

best_synergy.reason: Synergizes team firepower with Kongming's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.
Synergizes team firepower with Li Bai's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.

strong_against.reason: Can exploit Luban No. 7's skill windows to close the gap and overwhelm him with point-blank combos.
Can exploit Xiao Qiao's skill windows to close the gap and overwhelm her with point-blank combos.

weak_against.reason: Gets poked down before engaging by Ganjiang & Moye's long-range kiting and true damage.
Gets poked down before engaging by Arli's long-range kiting and true damage.

synergy.reason: Synergizes team firepower with Kongming's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.
Synergizes team firepower with Li Bai's frontline engage to guarantee teamfight victories.

passive.skill_name: Passive Skill: Wish of the Living
passive.description:
At close range, Devara's Basic Attacks become melee attacks that have shorter attack intervals and grant 1 stack of Thunder Resolve, for up to 6 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, Devara calls upon the power of thunder, gaining one extra basic skill use.
After using a basic skill, Devara gains an enhanced Basic Attack that deals an extra 85 (85 + 45% magical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and recovers 75 (75 + 1.2% extra max health) Health.
Ranged enhanced Basic Attacks deal 75% damage to non-target units and do not trigger on-hit effects.

skill1.description: Devara charges forward like lightning, dealing 240 (240 + 50% magical attack) magical damage to enemies in his path and gaining a shield that negates 360 (360 + 5.5% extra max health) damage for 2.5s.

skill2.description:
Devara unleashes a ball of lightning forward. Upon reaching its max range or colliding with an enemy, the lightning explodes after a short delay, knocking back enemies and dealing 240 (240 + 50% magical attack) magical damage.
The closer the unit is to Devara, the farther they are knocked back.

skill3.description:
Devara responds to an echo across millennia, rising into the air as he enters the Legacy Manifest state.
The transformation takes 1.5s, during which he ignores terrain and gains crowd control immunity and 30% movement speed. The golden staff at his back strikes nearby enemies in succession, prioritizing heroes. Each strike deals 100 (100 + 22% magical attack) magical damage, while also granting him 1 Thunder Resolve and a shield that negates 160 (160 + 2.5% extra max health) damage for 2s. Upon landing, he deals 200 (200 + 45% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies.
He remains transformed for 8s, during which the range of his enhanced Basic Attacks is increased, Basic Attacks grant 2 Thunder Resolve, and ranged Basic Attacks create chain lightning that bounces between multiple enemies, dealing 86 (50% physical attack) physical damage.

synergy.reason: She controls enemies to create a guaranteed opening, setting up the perfect situation to dive and start combos.
Her shields and peel greatly increase survivability when diving deep into the enemy team.

counters.reason: With his own cleanse and stun, he can easily turn the fight and punish any dives.
Her high mobility allows her to kite away, dealing high burst damage to poke them down before they can even engage.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Spear Will - Sweeping Fire
passive.description: Ying is mentally linked with her spear, Sweeping Fire. Using skills grants 1 stack of Spear Will. Basic Attacks expend all Spear Will, use the corresponding Spear Will skill (Stalwart - Peacemaker, Zealous - Devastation, or Zenith - Wildfire), and reduce Moonslash and Cloudchaser Cooldown by 1.5s. Spear Will skills can crit and benefit from 50% of Attack Speed.

forms.description: Ying swings her spear upward, then slashes downward, executing 2 strikes that each deal 180 (+60% extra physical damage). The upward strike launches enemies for 0.5s.

Ying flourishes her spear and attacks repeatedly, gaining 25% Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 124 (55 + 40% extra physical damage) to enemies over 4 strikes, and gaining a shield that negates damage equal to 260 (+4.5% extra Health) for 2s. This skill is cast by using an enhanced Basic Attack at 1 stack of Spear Will.

Ying raises her spear and charges up, gaining up to 25% Movement Speed. After charging, she dashes forward and executes a horizontal sweep, dealing 180 (+60% extra physical damage) - 360 (+120% extra physical damage) to enemies and slowing them by 15% for 1s.

Ying strikes 3 times, dealing 129 (60 + 40% extra physical damage) with each of the first two strikes and restoring 90 (+1.3% extra Health) Health. The final strike deals 258 (120 + 80% extra physical damage) and restores 180 (+2.5% extra Health) Health. This skill is cast by using an enhanced Basic Attack at 2 stacks of Spear Will. The lower her Health, the greater the recovery effect (up to 2x).

Ying ignites Sweeping Fire's tip and dashes back and forth through the area before her. Each dash deals 180 (+60% extra physical damage) and launches enemies. Upon dashing to maximum range, she launches a flurry of stabs. Each stab deals 90 (+30% extra physical damage), for a total of 4 stabs. While using this skill, Ying gains crowd control immunity and 30% damage reduction. Upon activating the second phase of the skill, Roaring Sun, she sweeps forward with Sweeping Fire, leaving a trail of fire behind. The sweep deals 180 (+60% extra physical damage), and the trail of fire deals 50 (+16% extra physical damage) magical damage every 0.2s over 3s, for a total of 1 time. While Starburn is active, the second phase of the skill can be used to sweep the area around her, interrupting subsequent dashes, dealing 120 (+40% extra physical damage), and leaving a circular trail of fire behind for 3s.

Ying leaps into the air and charges up before unleashing a sweeping strike, dealing 333 (160 + 100% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path. The lower the target's Health, the greater the damage, up to a maximum of 666 (320 + 200% extra physical damage) when the target's Health is below 50%. This skill is cast by using an enhanced Basic Attack at 3 stacks of Spear Will. While airborne, Ying ignores terrain, gains 200% Movement Speed, and gains 10% damage reduction.

synergy.reason: She absorbs enemy aggro and CC in teamfights, creating an opening to safely join the fight.
By disrupting the frontline, she makes it easy to pick off isolated enemies or squishy backline targets.

counters.reason: His point-and-click hard CC guarantees lockdown, completely shutting down high mobility like wall-hopping.
His strong suppression stops any flank attempts in their tracks, leaving them vulnerable to get focused down by the enemy.

passive.description: Feyd can move freely on walls, where his Basic Attacks become ranged (and can be used while jumping). He gains the following while on top of a wall: Jade Carriage: Stocks Stepping on Jade uses 10% faster. View from Above: Gains 15% increased field of vision. Crowd Control Penalty: Crowd controls last 25% longer.

skill1.description: Feyd moves swiftly forward, dealing 360 (360 + 110% extra AD) physical damage to enemies in his path and launching them for 3/4s. At the same time, he gains 50% Attack Speed and enhances his next 3 Basic Attacks. Melee: Each attack deals 75 (75 + 20% extra AD) physical damage and restores 155 (155 + 1.5% extra HP) Health. Ranged: Each attack deals 50 (50 + 13% extra AD) physical damage and bounces to the nearest unit within range on hit.

skill2.description: When on the ground: Feyd leaps onto the target wall. The leap's range increases by 4% for each skill level. When on a wall: Feyd steps on jade, jumping to the target wall. Stocks 1 use of this skill every 10s, for up to 4 uses.

skill3.description: Feyd swings his jade blade in a horizontal sweep around him, dealing 270 (270 + 80% extra AD) physical damage. (If he's on a wall, he will dash to the target area, then slash.) He marks all hit enemies and activates the skill's second phase, Hardened Jade Strike. Hardened Jade Strike: Feyd slashes each marked target 4 times, causing the marks to shatter, dealing 160 (160 + 50% extra AD) physical damage that ignores untargetable states. If a target's Health falls below 1/8, they will be Jadeified and shatter, being defeated.

synergy.reason: Providing shields, she extends the time Alessio can deal damage while airborne.
Clumping enemies up allows Alessio to maximize the AoE damage of his basic attacks.

counters.reason: With high mobility and burst damage, he can quickly delete targets before they have a chance to escape.
Her insane instantaneous burst damage can easily punish and disrupt Alessio's positioning.

passive.description: Alessio's Basic Attack fires a shell that deals area damage, plus extra physical damage equal to 0.5% of the target's max Health. While he is grounded, the shell can be blocked by enemy heroes.

skill1.description: Alessio enhances his next 3 Basic Attacks to use upgraded shells, which have a greater area of effect and deal 180 (180 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage and extra physical damage equal to 1% of the target's max Health.

skill2.description: Alessio throws a smoke bomb, creating a smoke cloud that grants stealth to himself and his teammates for 3.5s. The bomb's explosion sends him into the air, granting him Movement Speed for 0.8s. While airborne, he can move and use Basic Attacks and skills while ignoring terrain. Using Basic Attacks or the Ultimate while airborne causes him to stay airborne longer. While airborne, Skill 2 will not throw smoke bombs, and Basic Attacks cannot be blocked by enemies.

skill3.description: Alessio leaps into the air, gaining brief crowd control immunity, then locks onto an enemy hero and fires 5 shells at them, with each shell dealing 350 (350 + 80% extra physical attack) (+6% of target's lost Health) physical damage to enemies within the explosion's range. If the same target is hit by multiple shells, subsequent shells only deal 25% damage. Only 1 shell can be diverted to another enemy hero other than the locked-on target.

synergy.reason: By engaging the teamfight and disrupting enemies, he creates a safe environment for Luara to output damage.
He acts as a durable frontline tank, peeling enemy assassins away from Luara.

counters.reason: Her high mobility allows her to bypass Luara's kiting and consistently deal damage.
His high burst damage can instantly delete Luara before she has a chance to scale.

passive.description: Luara's Basic Attacks unleash serpent blades to attack enemies, dealing physical damage. For every enemy hit, her Skill 1 CD is reduced by 0.15s. Serpent blades come with a 30% on-hit effect and grant vision of the enemy hit. Each serpent blade lasts 6s, and up to 2 serpent blades can be active at one time.

skill1.description: Luara gains a serpent blade that attacks the target continuously over 6s, dealing 74 (40 + 20% physical attack) physical damage each time. She also gains a 45% Movement Speed boost that diminishes over 2s and can quickly scale walls should she run into them during this time. The speed of her serpent blades increases along with her level, up to a maximum increase of 25%.

skill2.description: Luara summons the Fire Serpent at the target location. After a short delay, the Fire Serpent charges at her, dealing 320 (320 + 80% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 25% for 2s. If she has active serpent blades, they will immediately strike the enemies hit by the Fire Serpent. If she doesn't have active serpent blades, her Skill 2's CD will be reduced by 50% instead. The cast point animation of this skill speeds up with her Attack Speed.

skill3.description: Luara summons the Fire Serpent in the target direction, dealing 480 (480 + 120% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies along the way and blinding them for 2s. She immediately gains 1 serpent blade and enhances herself for 6s. Attacking enemies or taking damage during this period accumulates Fury. At max Fury, she deals 240 (240 + 60% extra physical attack) magical damage to enemies within range and launches them for 0.5s. Blinded enemies cannot deal damage with Basic Attacks, and their skill projectiles will randomly deviate from their usual trajectories.

synergy.reason: She can chain her powerful AoE burst with the terrain and CC created by Ata.
It's easy for her to land skills and secure kills when Ata isolates and locks down enemies.

counters.reason: He can deal one-sided damage from long range, completely denying Ata's engage.
Her high mobility dodges Ata's skills, while her high armor penetration bursts down tanks instantly.

passive.skill_name: Passive Skill: Child of the Sea
passive.description: Ata's lost Health is stored in a buffer for 7s, and he recovers Health from the buffer equal to 40%/20% of the damage he deals to enemy heroes / non-hero units respectively (recovery is increased by 1%/0.5% for every 1,000 extra Max Health). After 7s, Ata's buffered Health will diminish by 3% Max Health per second. Basic Attacks deal 70 (70 + 35% extra physical damage) extra physical damage.

skill1.description: Ata leaps and slams his anchor into the ground, dealing 460 (460 + 13% extra Max Health) physical damage. He then bounces forward, dealing the same amount of physical damage and launching enemies within range for 0.5s. If he hits multiple enemies, the damage is reduced by 20% for each additional enemy, down to 60% of the initial damage. Deals 30% extra damage to minions. After the bounce, he rolls in the target direction. He gains crowd control immunity while using this skill.

skill2.description: Ata hurls his anchor in the target direction, dealing 225 (225 + 70% extra physical damage) to enemies in its path and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s. If the anchor hits a wall, Ata will pull himself and any enemies in his path to the wall and smash into it, dealing 250 (250 + 10% extra Max Health) physical damage and stunning any enemies smashed for 0.5s. Passive: Using Skill 2 enhances the next Basic Attack, pulling the target enemy to Ata.

skill3.description: Ata erects a high wall in a cone-shaped target area that blocks heroes and lasts for 4s. When erected, the wall deals 350 (350 + 120% extra physical damage) to enemies in front of him. While using the Ultimate, he gains crowd control immunity.

synergy.reason: She provides CC and strongly supports her high-mobility engages.
His cleanse greatly boosts her survivability when she dives into the enemy team.

counters.reason: With his own cleanse and stun, he easily shuts down her combo attempts.
His point-and-click stun completely locks down her mobility.

passive.description:
When attacking distant targets, Umbrosa's Basic Attack throws out a rebounding blade. She can only attack again once the blade returns. However, if she uses her Basic Attack just before the blade returns, it will instantly rebound forward for another strike.
While in ranged mode, every 1% Attack Speed increases her damage by 1.5. Each consecutive rebound of the blade further increases its damage and flight speed by 5%, stacking up to 3 times.
When attacking nearby targets, Umbrosa switches to melee mode. Her Basic Attack becomes a flurry of 3 rapid strikes, dealing a total of 110% physical damage.
Each Basic Attack applies a Mark to the enemy. Marked enemies take extra damage when hit by Feathered Tempest.

skill1.description:
Umbrosa sweeps the surrounding area, dealing 250 (250 + 80% extra physical attack) physical damage and slowing enemies by 15% for 2s.
She then enters the Frenzied state for 3s, during which she gains 25% Movement Speed that diminishes over time and 60% Attack Speed.

skill2.description:
Umbrosa dashes forward, knocking back enemies in her path (not considered a crowd control effect) and dealing 150 (150 + 50% extra physical attack) physical damage. At the same time, she triggers the Featherblade marks of all hit targets and spreads them to nearby enemies.
If there are enemies ahead, Umbrosa performs a graceful dance, throwing flying blades that strike 8 times, each dealing 110 (110 + 38% extra physical attack) physical damage and recovering 45 (45 + 0.8% extra Health) Health (healing is halved when hitting non-hero units). If Umbrosa is in the Indomitable state, the final strike deals an extra 100% damage. Each hit consumes 1 stack of the target's marks, dealing an extra 40 (40 + 15% extra physical attack) physical damage.
She can move freely while dancing, and using the skill again will cancel its effects. If the dance is not triggered, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 60% of the original.

skill3.description:
Umbrosa reignites her former glory as an Austren, dealing 400 (400 + 140% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies while gaining 50% temporary Health and 50% Movement Speed that diminishes over time. She also enters the Indomitable state for 4s. Any recovery effects will be tallied only after the state ends.
If Umbrosa is defeated while this skill is not on cooldown, she will resurrect after a short delay. Upon resurrecting, she will deal 400 (400 + 140% extra physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies, and this skill will enter cooldown.
Passive: When leveling up this skill, Feathered Tempest gains an additional 2 strikes of damage, while her melee Basic Attack gains an additional 1 strike of damage. Additional strikes deal 50 physical damage each.
If her temporary Health is expended, she will immediately exit the Indomitable state. When she resurrects, she only gains 50% of the Health she would have gained if the skill were actively used.

synergy.reason: She can reset his cooldowns, allowing Heino to cast his powerful ultimate back-to-back.
Combining her teleports with Heino's time-reversal ultimate makes returning to fights and regenerating effortless.

counters.reason: She can instantly close the gap and burst down Heino before he has a chance to heal.
His strong CC can lock down Heino, setting up a kill before he can ever use his ultimate.

passive.description:
Heino engages in combat in either melee or ranged mode as fate dictates. His skills and melee Basic Attacks mark enemies for 7s on hit.
Ranged: He channels the Power of Fate to attack distant enemies, dealing 165 (100% physical damage) physical damage and (15% magical damage) magical damage.
Melee: He brandishes his scepter to attack all nearby enemies, dealing 165 (100% physical damage) physical damage and (45% magical damage) magical damage.

skill1.description:
Heino reduces his cooldown by 0.2s for each marked enemy hit, up to 1s.
Ranged: He turns his scepter into energy and throws it, dealing 410 (410 + 75% magical damage) magical damage upon hit. He also throws 1 extra scepter at every marked enemy in front of him, dealing 75% damage.
Melee: He throws his scepter spinning, dealing 260 (260 + 45% magical damage) magical damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 15% for 2s. He recovers 150 (150 + 5% extra Health) Health for each target hit.
Ranged: When extra scepters hit the same target multiple times, subsequent hits only deal 50% of the initial damage. Melee: Recovers Health up to 3 times.

skill2.description:
Heino dashes forward. If there are no enemy heroes near the end of the dash, he goes into ranged mode. Otherwise, he goes into melee mode.
Ranged: Gains 15% Movement Speed for 2s. For each enemy hero near the starting point of the dash, his Movement Speed increases by 25%, up to 50%. If Skill 2 causes him to switch from melee to ranged mode, both the Movement Speed increase and its limit are doubled.
Melee: Gains 100 Physical and Magical Defense, and recovers 450 (450 + 12% extra Health) Health while increasing max Health by the same amount. For each enemy hero near the endpoint of the dash, his Health recovery increases by 25%, up to 50%. If Skill 2 causes him to switch from ranged to melee mode, both the Health recovery and its limit are doubled.

skill3.description:
Heino leaves behind a memory whenever he changes to ranged mode. He creates a field that grants 15% damage reduction and recovers 400 (400 + 6% extra Health) Health. During this time, he has crowd control immunity but cannot move. After a 1.5s delay, the field deals 400 (400 + 100% magical damage) magical damage and he returns to the memory he left behind. If there is an allied tower within the field, that tower returns to its state from 5s earlier.
The lower his Health, the more Health he recovers, up to 2 times the base value.

synergy.reason: He can easily follow up on Mayene's CC and knockups with his high burst damage to secure kills.
His long-range stuns are perfect for setting up Mayene's combos.

counters.reason: His reliable silence completely shuts down Mayene, who relies heavily on skill combos.
His unavoidable suppression can forcefully lock down the highly mobile Mayene.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Slack Off a Lil Bit
passive.description: Mayene's skills consume Punch Strength or Kick Strength. When idle and not taking damage, she sits down to slack off, accelerating Strength recovery by 25%. While slacking, she snacks on treats, randomly recovering 110 (+2% extra Health) x 1/1.5/2 Health. Attacking, taking damage, or moving interrupts this effect. She won't slack off in Serious State. Using a different skill combo within 3s of another boosts its effect by 25%.

forms.description: Mayene runs forward and pulls in enemies in front of her, dealing 300 (+100% extra physical damage) to enemies in a cone-shaped area and slowing them by 30% for 1s. Costs 1 Punch Strength. Recovers 1 Punch Strength every 8.5s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), max 2 bars.

Exploit Weakness: When using Whatever (I) again quickly after, she will leap into the air and deliver a powerful strike, dealing 400 (+125% extra physical damage) to enemies within range and extra physical damage equal to 10% of the target's Health, as well as launching them for 1s. Deals 50% extra damage to enemies in the center. Mayene takes 25% less damage while using the skill.

Feint to Retreat: Mayene delivers a smooth combo of strikes, starting with 3 punches that deal 200 (+70% extra physical damage) each, followed by a knee strike that deals 200 (+70% extra physical damage) while pushing the target backward slightly. She also recovers 200 (+5% extra Health) Health.

Mayene flips forward, during which she has crowd control immunity, gains 30% damage reduction and recovers 200 (+5% extra Health) Health. Costs 1 Kick Strength. Recovers 1 Kick Strength every 8.5s (affected by Cooldown Reduction), max 2 bars.

Flee Danger: When using Whatever (II) again quickly after, she delivers a flying kick to the enemy, dealing 500 (+150% extra physical damage) and recovering 200 (+5% extra Health) Health. She then somersaults into the air, gaining CC immunity, 25% damage reduction, and recovering 300 (+5% extra Health) Health.

Defend by Attacking: When using Whatever (I) quickly after, she blinks behind the enemy and delivers a spinning kick, knocking back the target and dealing 350 (+110% extra physical damage) (+15% target's lost Health) physical damage. If the target is defeated, recovers 300 (+5% extra Health) Health and 50% Strength (doubled for hero kills).

skill3.name: Skill 3: Get Serious
skill3.description: Mayene gets serious, dealing 360 (+100% extra physical damage) to nearby enemies. Upon entering the Serious State, she recovers 1 Punch Strength and Kick Strength, and max Strength is increased to 3 bars each. The Serious State lasts for 10s, during which she gains 15% Movement Speed, and any slowing effect inflicted on her is reduced by 50%.

synergy.reason: She heavily benefits from Dyadia's gold advantage, accelerating her power spike as a carry.
When an assassin dives the backline, she can use her ultimate to heal and peel from a safe distance.

counters.reason: His ambush from stealth can instantly delete her before she can even use her support skills.
Being locked down by hard CC completely neutralizes her ability to heal or support the team.

passive.description: Dyadia enhances her next Basic Attack every 7.5-6s (decreases with hero level): She swings toward the enemy, dealing 379 (210 + 100% physical damage + 30% magical damage) magical damage and knocking them back, then jumps back using the momentum. When a teammate receives Blessing of Fate (does not trigger at full Health; Gold halved if used on teammates with more than 50% Health), or an enemy hero is affected by Bitter Reconciliation, she earns an extra 20 Gold and reduces the preparation time of her enhanced Basic Attack by 50%.

skill1.description: Dyadia blesses a teammate with fated bond, restoring 200 (200 + 30% magical damage) Health. For the next 5s, heroes blessed with fated bond gain 30% Movement Speed when they move toward each other. When they come close, Blessing of Fate is triggered, restoring 400 (400 + 60% magical damage) Health to both and maintaining the Movement Speed boost for 2s. If she uses the skill again on a teammate already blessed with fated bond, she will dash to them and instantly trigger Blessing of Fate. The teammate recovers 400 (400 + 60% magical damage) Health and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s, while Dyadia recovers 400 (400 + 60% magical damage + 8% extra Health) Health. She can use this skill again within 5s. If it is not used again, the cooldown will be reset.

skill2.description: Dyadia marks an enemy with a bitter bond, exposing them and dealing 45 (45 + 6% magical damage) magical damage while penalizing them with a loss of 2 Gold (does not affect non-hero units) every second for 5s. When the effect ends, it deals an extra 225 (225 + 30% magical damage) magical damage. When two enemies with bitter bond move toward each other, they are slowed by 25%. When they come close, Bitter Reconciliation is triggered, stopping them from taking more damage and returning the penalized Gold. If she uses the skill again on a target already affected by bitter bond, she will dash to them, triggering Bitter Reconciliation, immobilizing them for 0.75s and dealing a total of 600 (600 + 80% magical damage) magical damage. During this time, she takes 25% less damage (this effect is doubled against the affected target). The penalized Gold is held by Dyadia. If the target defeats/assists in defeating her, they will recover 100%/50% of the Gold respectively. She can use this skill again within 5s. If it is not used again, the cooldown will be reset.

skill3.description: Dyadia commands a swarm of wisps to fly forward, granting fated bond to teammates in their path, restoring 250 (250 + 40% magical damage) Health, and inflicting bitter bond on enemies in their path, dealing 320 (320 + 40% magical damage) magical damage. If a teammate already has fated bond, the duration is refreshed. They also recover an extra 150 (150 + 25% magical damage) Health and gain 30% Movement Speed for 2s. If an enemy already has bitter bond, the duration is refreshed. They also take an extra 200 (200 + 30% magical damage) magical damage and are immobilized for 1s. Passive: Each time Dyadia gains 1 extra Gold from using a skill, the base Health restored and magical damage dealt from Destined Encounter are increased by 1.

synergy.reason: Acts as a frontline meatshield to peel for low-mobility marksmen against enemy dives.
Locks down multiple enemies with strong CC, allowing the mage to safely unleash massive AoE damage.

counters.reason: Can completely ignore the tank's high survivability with armor penetration and percentage-based damage.
Possesses true damage that ignores shields and physical defense, making it impossible to tank.

passive.description: Flowborn can draw the Flow into their body at the Base to enhance stats. Vitality: Increases max Health by 300 and Physical and Magical Defense by 50. Piercing Heart: Increases max Health by 300 and Physical Attack by 30. Haste: Increases max Health by 300 and Movement Speed by 3.5%. Focus: Increases max Health by 300 and Cooldown Reduction by 5%. Spend 1 stack of Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals 408 (220 + 100% AD + 4% extra max Health) physical damage and recover 125 (125 + 2.5% extra max Health) Health.

skill1.description: Flowborn channels the Flow, reducing the cooldown of other skills by 50% while gaining 5 stacks of Flow and recovering 150 (150 + 4% extra max Health) Health. Gains 1 extra stack and recovers extra Health for every teammate and every 2 minions nearby, for up to 9 stacks and double the recovery. Flowborn deals 100 (100 + 2% extra max Health) physical damage to nearby enemies and knocks them back (without applying crowd control).

skill2.description: Flowborn charges toward the target, knocking back enemies in the path, then slashes forward to deal 600 (600 + 185% extra AD) physical damage and gain a 350 (350 + 7% extra max Health) shield for 3s. Using this skill continuously on the same target for 1.5s changes its effects in the following order. Clearing Slash: Deals equal slash damage to enemies, launches them for 0.33s, and gains a shield of the same amount. Rifting Slash: Deals equal slash damage to enemies, launches them for 0.66s, and gains a shield of the same amount. If the skill is not on cooldown, spend 4 stacks of Flow to stop it from entering cooldown after this use. All non-hero units within range of this skill are affected by the same crowd control effect.

skill3.description: Flowborn leaps to the target location and attacks, dealing 400 (400 + 70% extra AD + 8% extra max Health) physical damage and knocking back enemies for 0.75s. Deals an extra 50% damage at the center of the attack. If the skill is not on cooldown, can spend 5 stacks of Flow to stop it from entering cooldown after this use.

synergy.reason: Locks down enemies with strong CC and shields, guaranteeing the mage can land their full skill combo.
Draws enemy aggro on the frontline, creating space to safely output sustained magic damage from a distance.

counters.reason: Closes the gap with overwhelming mobility and bursts them down before they can even cast a skill.
Possesses undodgeable point-and-click hard CC that completely neutralizes all mobility.

passive.description: Flowborn can draw the Flow into their body at the Base to enhance stats (increases with level). Vitality: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and max Health by 300. Piercing Heart: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and Magical Pierce by 50. Haste: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and Movement Speed by 3.5%. Focus: Increases Magical Attack by 50 and Cooldown Reduction by 5%. Can spend 1 stack of Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals 60 (60 + 12% AP) magical damage to enemies within range.

skill1.description: Flowborn channels the Flow, reducing the cooldown of other skills by 50% while gaining 5 stacks of Flow and recovering 150 (150 + 4% extra max Health) Health. Gains 1 extra stack and recovers extra Health for every teammate and every 2 minions nearby, for up to 9 stacks and double the recovery. Flowborn deals 100 (100 + 20% AP) magical damage to nearby enemies and knocks them back (without applying crowd control).

skill2.description: Flowborn controls the nearby Flow and conjures a magic circle, dealing 325 (325 + 65% AP) magical damage to enemies within range and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The magic circle deals 65 (65 + 13% AP) magical damage for 1.5s every 0.5s. Can use this skill continuously over 1.5s, with new effects in the following order. Launching Flow: Deals the same damage to enemies and launches them for 0.5s. Stunning Flow: Deals the same damage to enemies and stuns them for 0.5s. If used within the initial magic circle, both additional uses refresh the magic circle's duration and increase damage over time by 50%. Can spend 4 stacks of Flow to use the skill without triggering cooldown. The inner area of all circles inflicts an extra 50% crowd control effect.

skill3.description: Flowborn channels the Flow into a beam, dealing 700 (700 + 140% AP) magical damage to enemies in its path. The beam will link with an enemy hero within range and continuously unleash Energy Bombs, dealing 350 (350 + 70% AP) magical damage to the area around the target. Can spend 5 stacks of Flow to stop the skill from entering cooldown after this use. Other skills can be used during this skill.

synergy.reason: Boosts backline survivability with shields, keeping them safe until their late-game damage scaling kicks in.
Stabilizes the laning phase with high sustain and protection, allowing the marksman to scale and shine.

counters.reason: Instantly deletes squishy marksmen with stealth engages and high burst damage.
Dives the backline with overwhelming mobility, bursting them down before there's any time to react.

passive.description: Flowborn can draw the Flow into their body at the Base, increasing Attack Speed by 10%-20% (increases with hero level) and enhancing one of four other stats. Vitality: Increases max Health by 300. Piercing Heart: Increases Physical Attack by 30. Haste: Increases Movement Speed by 3.5%. Focus: Increases Cooldown Reduction by 5%. Enhanced Basic Attack: Fires a piercing projectile, dealing 80 (80 + 20% extra AD) physical damage to enemies in its path. Hitting an enemy extends its travel distance while reducing damage by 30%. Each enhanced Basic Attack consumes 1 stack of Flow.

skill1.description: Flowborn channels the Flow, dealing 100 (100 + 25% extra AD) physical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back (without applying crowd control). Also recovers 150 (150 + 4% extra max Health) Health, gains 5 stacks of Flow, and reduces the cooldown of Arrow of No Retreat and Arrowstorm by 50%. Nearby teammates and minions increase the recovery (up to 100%) and stacks of Flow (up to 9 stacks).

skill2.description: Flowborn shoots an enormous projectile at the target (can be blocked by enemy heroes), dealing 450 (450 + 120% extra AD) physical damage and knocking back non-hero units. Flowborn can dash a short distance upon use (use it again within 1.5s to become enhanced). Second Use: Enhances projectile damage by 25%. Third Use: Levitates and enhances projectile damage by 50%. Can spend 4 stacks of Flow to use this skill again. Casting speed increases with Attack Speed.

skill3.description: Flowborn shoots 7 volleys of light projectiles at the target location (casting speed increases with Attack Speed), dealing 90 (50 + 24% AD) physical damage (every 3 projectiles counts as 1 Basic Attack). Projectiles lock on to targets within range. Also gains a 10% Movement Speed increase. Use this skill again to levitate. Can spend 5 stacks of Flow to use this skill again.

synergy.reason: His AoE cleanse and CC immunity allow Florentino to continuously output damage and pick up flowers without his combos being interrupted.
By clumping enemies up, he massively increases the hit rate of Florentino's flower toss (Skill 1), letting him wipe out multiple targets at once.

counters.reason: His uncleansable suppression ultimate completely stops Florentino's fancy footwork and combos, leaving him vulnerable to getting burst down by the team.
His long-duration suppression ultimate forcefully interrupts Florentino's combo mechanics, completely neutralizing him.

passive.name: Passive: Sword Steps
passive.description:
When leaving combat or touching a bouquet, Florentino empowers his next Basic Attack (the effect lasts 5s after touching a bouquet). He dashes forward, dealing 160 (160 + 50% extra physical attack) physical damage, and recovers 140 (140 + 2% extra max Health) Health when hitting a hero (recovery is halved against non-hero units).
After the dash ends, he can quickly move a short distance.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Bloom
skill1.description:
Florentino throws a bouquet, dealing 300 (300 + 95% extra physical attack) physical damage to the first enemy hit and stunning them for 0.75s, then creates 3 bouquets around the target for 3.5s.
Touching a bouquet empowers his Basic Attack and resets the cooldown of Triple Slash.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Triple Slash
skill2.description:
Florentino strikes the target 3 times with his sword.
1st hit: deals 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage and greatly reduces the target's Movement Speed for 1s.
2nd hit: deals 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage.
3rd hit: deals 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) physical damage (in 2 stages).
Each strike deals an additional 130 (130 + 40% extra physical attack) true damage to the target and reduces the cooldown of Bloom by 1s.
The first 2 strikes have a 1.5s cooldown. The skill goes on cooldown after the 3rd strike. After the attack ends, he can quickly move a short distance.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Gentleman's Duel
skill3.description:
Florentino dashes in the target direction, marking the first enemy hero hit and increasing the damage they take by 10% for 5s, then creates 3 bouquets nearby.
While the skill lasts, the Health recovery of Sword Steps' empowered Basic Attack is doubled and he gains crowd control immunity (extended by 1s each time he touches a bouquet, lasts 3s).
Touching a bouquet empowers his Basic Attack and resets the cooldown of Triple Slash.
After the dash ends, he can quickly move a short distance.

synergy.reason: While Lorion's massive AoE knockup ultimate locks down multiple enemies, Marco Polo can safely unleash his full ultimate.
Chaining Lian Po's strong engage into Lorion's orb placement and ultimate creates a CC chain that devastates the enemy backline.

counters.reason: Zhuangzi's ultimate (team-wide CC immunity) completely negates Lorion's biggest strength: his massive AoE knockup ultimate.
With high mobility and i-frames, she easily dodges Lorion's Skill 1 orb placement and his ultimate's AoE.

skill_order.linked_note: Note: Leveling up Skill 2 also upgrades Skill 3.

passive.name: Passive: Eternity
passive.description:
Skill Activation: Deals damage on hit and activates the orb.
While the orb is outside his body, the activated orb deals 59 (59 + 12% magical attack) magical damage every 0.75s for 4s to the unit with the lowest Health in range.
While the orb is inside his body, the activated orb damages all units in range, its attack frequency is doubled, and it recovers 25 (25 + 0.4% extra Health) Health (halved for non-hero units).

skill1.name: Skill 1: Where My Will Reaches
skill1.description:
Lorion moves the orb to the target position, dealing 220 (220 + 44% magical attack) magical damage to units along its path. On hit at the destination, the orb activates and deals an additional 150 (150 + 30% magical attack) magical damage. While the orb is outside his body, casting this skill deals 250 (250 + 50% magical attack) magical damage to units between the orb's starting point and destination and reduces their Movement Speed by 20% for 1.5s.
Moving a certain distance away from the orb recalls it into his body.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Abyssal Pact
skill2.description:
While the orb is outside his body, Lorion recalls it into his body and activates it, dealing 150 (150 + 30% magical attack) magical damage and increasing his Movement Speed by 20% for 2s.
While the orb is inside his body, the cooldown is reduced by 30%.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Advent of the Dark God
skill3.description:
While the orb is outside his body, Lorion flies toward the orb and activates it, dealing 150 (150 + 30% magical attack) magical damage. While casting, he takes 25% reduced damage (lasts 2s after the flight ends) and gains crowd control immunity.
While the orb is inside his body, the cooldown is reduced by 30%.

skill4.name: Skill 4: Star of the Dark Night
skill4.description:
Lorion detonates the orb after 2s, dealing 600 (600 + 120% magical attack) magical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them up for 1.25s.
Casting the ultimate grants 1 stack of Skill 1.
If the ultimate does not hit a hero, its cooldown is reduced by 50%.

synergy.reason: Annette's ultimate (wind wall) completely shuts out enemy assassin dives, allowing the marksman to attack freely from the safety of the backline.
The wind wall keeps melee heroes at bay, allowing her to safely output damage from out of range.

counters.reason: They dish out heavy poke damage from far beyond the wind wall's range, easily overwhelming Annette's squishy health pool.
His high burst damage can potentially delete Annette before she even has time to deploy her ultimate.

passive.name: Passive: Whisper of the Wind
passive.description: Moving reduces skill cooldowns and restores Mana. When an ally is nearby, Movement Speed is increased by 25.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Premonition of Storm
skill1.description:
Annette summons a magic circle at the target position (triggers every 0.5s, lasts 4s). The magic circle deals 160 (160 + 28% magical attack) magical damage to enemy units and reduces their Movement Speed by 5% (up to 5 stacks, lasts 1s).
The magic circle increases allied units' Movement Speed by 5% (up to 5 stacks, lasts 1s).

skill2.name: Skill 2: Wind Guard
skill2.description:
Annette launches an orb in the target direction (bouncing herself in the opposite direction), gaining a 400 (400 + 6% extra magical attack) shield for 3s and 75 bonus Movement Speed for 2s.
The orb deals 300 (300 + 50% magical attack) magical damage to enemies it hits and grants allies it hits a 400 (400 + 6% extra magical attack) shield.
If the orb touches a magic circle from Premonition of Storm, it carries the magic circle to its destination.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Veil of the Spring Breeze
skill3.description:
Annette summons a barrier around herself (lasts 4s, can move), knocking back enemies in range and dealing 300 (300 + 50% magical attack) magical damage. Enemies touching the barrier take the same damage and are stunned for 1.25s, while allies inside the barrier gain crowd control immunity.
While casting, Annette becomes untargetable and her Movement Speed is reduced by 50%.

synergy.reason: He grants CC immunity and damage reduction, allowing her to chain resets and secure kills uninterrupted.
His long-range stun can lock down enemies, creating a safe opening for Butterfly to dive.

counters.reason: His AoE CC and high sustain can easily break the chain of Butterfly's skill resets.
Her i-frames and healing allow her to dodge Butterfly's burst and easily turn the fight.

passive.description: Butterfly gains 2 marks from defeating heroes and 1 mark from assists and from killing monsters/minions. At 3 stacks, the next skill used will not enter cooldown.

skill1.description: Butterfly deals 362 (240 + 70% physical damage) to nearby enemies. Each extra enemy hit increases damage by 25%. Also gains a shield that negates 381 (250 + 75% Physical Attack) damage lasting 2s, and gains 50% Movement Speed that diminishes over time.

skill2.description: Butterfly deals 333 (220 + 65% physical damage) to enemies in her path. The first enemy hit takes 1.5 times this damage and is slowed by 50% for 1.5s. Hitting an enemy increases her Attack Speed by 25% and Critical Rate by 10% for 4s, for up to 2 stacks.

skill3.description: Butterfly jumps to a target enemy, dealing 557 (400 + 90% physical damage) (if the target is marked, deals extra true damage equal to 12% lost Health) and marking them for 4s. For 4s after hitting the target, she takes 50% less damage from all Basic Attacks. While the mark is active, she recovers Health equal to 35% of damage dealt to the target. If the target is defeated, it will immediately reset her Ultimate's cooldown. Hitting marked targets with Basic Attacks will also reduce the cooldown of Skills 1 and 2 by 1s.
